entries.title: The Revelation prt 14
entries.text: Tinokwazisana tose muZita raTenzi Jeso Kristu. [Congregation says “Amen.”] Tichikwazisa vatsvene vese vauya, pazuva ranhasi. [Congregation says “Amen.”] Tine mufaro kuva nemi mukati meimba yaMwari. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Tikuona hama dzeGweru. Saka tine mufaro kuva nadzo chaizvo. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Hama dzeKwekwe, tinofara kuva nemi. [Congregation says, “Amen.”]

entries.title: The Revelation prt 14
entries.text: Tichitenda Mwari nokuimba kwakanaka chai… ? [Congregation says, “chaizvo.”] Kuimba kwedu kuri kunakidza. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] I trust by God’s grace it gets better and…? [Congregation says, “better,”] better. Hama dza’akugona kutungamira nziyo zvakanaka chai…? [Congregation says, “chaizvo,”] chaizvo. Unopinda muMweya. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Dai zvaramba zvakadii…? [Congregation says, “zvakadaro,”] zvakadaro, Mwari vachitiitira nyasha. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Mufaro wedu chaiwo, kuti tive muKereke makadii…? [Apostle and Congregation say, “makadai.”] Hatirambei tichinamata.

entries.title: The Revelation prt 14
entries.text: I want to remind you again, let’s not forget October. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Today is a day of fas…? [Congregation says, “fasting,”] fasting. I want us to put October, very much in pra…? [Congregation says, “in prayer.”] Ehe, October hausi mwedzi wakanaka. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Kana muhope unenge uchingozviona kuti haah… [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Ha’moona?

entries.title: The Revelation prt 14
entries.text: Saka unenge uchingorarama like you’re expecting something. Maybe it’s psychological, one doesn’t know. Saka unenge uchiita seku expecter something. Unongoona, it’s just …?... Unenge usinganyatsofara zvakanaka. Saka ukambogara unotoona mind yako yadii... ya drifter, handitika?

entries.title: The Revelation prt 14
entries.text: Watobata shaya usingadii…? [Congregation says, “usingazive.”] Ehe. Wotozoudzwa nevamwe kunzi, “What’s going on?” Wozoziva kuti, “No, mind yangu yadii…? Yakanganisika.” [Congregation says, “mm.”] But today, I want everybody pa day re fasting, to pray rebuking that spirit. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Handika? Kuti tiwukurire, [Congregation says, “Amen,”] mweya uyu handitika? [Congregation says, “Amen.”]

entries.title: The Revelation prt 14
entries.text: Ehe, tibude… October na November. Zvagara November kuvanhu vatema hausi mwedzi wakadii…? [Congregation says, “wakanaka,”] wakanaka. So, let’s really pray for this period. Particularly this year. This year has been extra wonderful. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Ranga riri gore rakanaka chai…? [Congregation says, “chaizvo,”] chaizvo, muzvinhu zvose. Ha’moona?

entries.title: The Revelation prt 14
entries.text: Most people would expect a double portion, panyama chete. [Congregation says, “mm.”] But I was talking to Brother… Ndichitaura na Brother… aah, Nyathi pavasvika masikati. Ndikati, “Double portion iyika, it wasn’t so much gore rino panyama. [Congregation says, “mm.”] The double portion, Mwari vakatanga va dealer nesu pamweya.” [Congregation says, “Amen.”]

entries.title: The Revelation prt 14
entries.text: Hatisati takambo enjoyer kunamata nekuparidza, sezvatakaita gore …? [Congregation says, “gore rino.”] Amen. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] And I go back, all the Messages when I listen to them, atakaparidzirana gore rino iri. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] I even bemoan, ma Messages atisina ku taper, atakatanga panapa. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] They were so wo…? [Congregation says, “wonderful.”] Ha’moona? Zvokuti that’s when we realise kuti, “Ahh, vamwe vari kuma out uku, havana chavari kudii...? [Congregation says, “chavari kunzwa,”] chavari kunzwa.”

entries.title: The Revelation prt 14
entries.text: Mwari vakatanga ku dealer nesu muma Messages. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] The type of Messages we were getting, were wonderful Messages. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Zvekuti it’s impossible kuti munhu aregere kupona ipa…? [Congregation says, “ipapo,”] ipapo. Takaita ma Messages anovhangera, eh ano reviver, [Congregation says, “Amen,”] eh anopa munhu commitment, [Congregation says, “Amen,”] anoita kuti uite look forward to the next service. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Mwari vakanga vachitiitira nyasha chai...? [Congregation says, “chaizvo.”] Until coming for services… Ndozvaizvichitaura VaNyathi kuti, “It doesn’t become a struggle any…?” [Congregation says, “anymore.”]

entries.title: The Revelation prt 14
entries.text: Ehe, unongonzwa kuti, “Rega ndiende kuChechi.” [Congregation says, “mm.”] Ukange usiko ku Chechi unonzwa ku misser kuti, “No,” ha’maona? Same with me. I live to just take a service in the evening. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Ndinorara ndichifunga kutora service. Ndigomuka ndichifunga kutora service. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] So, it’s like, it’s not even difficult kuparidza kwacho. Wonyatsoona kuti Mwari vaita chii...? [Congregation says, “nyasha,”] nyasha.

entries.title: The Revelation prt 14
entries.text: I’ve been taking service none stop. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Ha’moona? But ndikangozorora Monday… “…They that wait upon the…” [Congregation says, “the Lord.”] Ehe, watoona wakutoenda, ha’moona? Then you have a lot of things that we’re doing here. Naturally you would lose your temper and get frustrated and shout at everybody every minute, snap up. But somehow God is granting grace dzisingaite. [Congregation says, “Amen.”]

entries.title: The Revelation prt 14
entries.text: Ukaenda ukapedzawo nema plumber, obva wotaurawo nema carpenter, wotaurawo nema brother, wota… Eh, wotora service yako. The pressure is on, ha’moona? But somehow, i—it’s—it’s under control. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Unonyatsoona kuti inyasha dzaani…? [Congregation says, “dzaMwari,”] dzaMwari, ha’mona?

entries.title: The Revelation prt 14
entries.text: Mazuva ekuti unonyatsonzwa kufara, [Congregation says, “Amen,”] ha’moona? And if the Lord would allow us not to be disturbed again. If He did not allow us not to be disturbed again, the way we were disturbed previously, this will be one of the greatest churches, [Congregation says, “Amen,”] ha’moona? Saka, not to say we won’t have people, do wrong things or say wrong things, or act wrongfully, we’ll always have them.

entries.title: The Revelation prt 14
entries.text: But condition yeChechi kana yakanaka, wo… no matter how big a problem is, it becomes very...? [Apostle and Congregation say, “very small.”] Then people will go over it, ha’moona? And above all, as much as you need my support in preaching and in prayer, but I think I need your support more. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] I need your support more than I—you need mine, [Congregation says, “Amen,”] in prayer kuti ndikwanise kunyatsomira pambe…? [Congregation says, “pamberi,”] pamberi. Ndikwanise kuwana ma Messages.

entries.title: The Revelation prt 14
entries.text: That’s why I wonder when the brother sings songs like Tichamira navo, whether they really do? [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Handi? [Apostle chuckles—ED] Amen, handika eh? Whether they really do eh… kumira nemunhu waani…? [Congregation says, “waMwari,”] waMwari. Muranda waShe tichamira navo. You don’t, eh, stand by the man of God when things are okay. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] I don’t need you then. But when I need you is when things are rou…? [Congregation says, “are rough,”] rough. That’s when I need your support.

entries.title: The Revelation prt 14
entries.text: I don’t need it when I’m alright, like thi—like this. But when things are like October 2000, ndo’patinobvunza kuti, “Eh, unomira navo here muranda waShe?” [Apostle chuckles—ED; Congregation says, “Amen.”] Amen. So, jo—don’t… Take a tendency of just not singing, but funga, [Congregation says, “Amen,”] ma words auri kudii…? [Congregation says, “auri kuimba,”] auri kuimba all the time, handi’moona ehe?

entries.title: The Revelation prt 14
entries.text: Ah, iye zvino ndiri kugara ndichitsvinyirana nema sister, ndikasangana nema sister ese every time handitika? Ehe nde’ndichingovamba: MuApostori ndiMwari pakati pedu. [Congregation laughs—ED] MuApostori ndiMwari pakati pedu. Ndiyaniko wakati Mwari… Iye munhu akuronga… [Apostle and Congregation laugh—ED] Munhu ari kuronga disappearance. You see what happe… [ Apostle laughs—ED] So, these are the kind of songs handika, that … Inini nzo—iyoyo ndakaida stereki. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Because it has really true meaning. Ende zvechokwadi payakaimbwa, mwana uyu chizaruro aive nani…? [Congregation says, “nacho,”] nacho.

entries.title: The Revelation prt 14
entries.text: Now look what the devil has done. You see, look what the devil has done. So, let’s guard against that. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Tese ngatipindei mumuteuro. Saka zuva ranhasi rino iri, izuva guru kwatiri. [Congregation says, “Amen.”]

entries.title: The Revelation prt 14
entries.text: Really, I’ve always felt kuti handisi kunyatsoziva kuti what should we do on this day, because nde’endichifunga kuti—ti—kuti hazviite kuti tingoita zuva here rese rokuna…? [Congregation says, “kunamata,”] kunamata. Kungouya tichinamata tichingoisa, because that’s what we would have done anywhere the whol…? [Congregation says, “the whole day.”]

entries.title: The Revelation prt 14
entries.text: So, we come our hearts pumping with faith. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Kuti Mwari tiitirei chii…? [Congregation says, “nyasha.”] Izuva rekuti tiise mumwe neumwe chinhu chake chaanenge aina...? [Congregation says, “ainacho,”] ainacho, ha’moona? So, God hasn’t really revealed to me exactly how to go about it, on this Friday, ha’moona? Kunze kwezvatanga tichingoita izvozvo. We’ll continue doing that until God, definitely shows us a way. But I think this day, eventually as it goes, we want to develop it to be a day of prayer. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Zuva remunamato chai…? [Congregation says, “chairo,”] chairo.

entries.title: The Revelation prt 14
entries.text: You know my children tend to believe that it’s—it’s everybody who prays on Friday. They think it’s—maybe everybody in Zimbabwe, [Congregation laughs—ED] prays on Friday. Vanga vachipupurira teacher wavo nhasi. Eh zvikanzi, “Ko imimi, munoenda kubhawa ne Friday riri zuva rekutsanya sei?” [Congregation laughs—ED] They are expecting their teachers also to—to be fasting on Fri…? [Apostle and Congregation say, “on Friday.”] Saka kwavarika, ratova zuva rekutsanya. Ndivana Keke ivavo, handi’moona eh? Vavapupurira zvikanzi, “Ende imi munoti munoenda ku Angrican asi munoputa fodya, ende munonwa chii…? [Congregation says, “doro,”] doro. Hapana kunamata kwakafanana naikoko.” [Congregation laughs—ED] Ha’maona, eh?

entries.title: The Revelation prt 14
entries.text: Zvikanzi, “Isu tiriva—vana vanotenda Shoko raMwari. Ende tiri Chechi—tinonamata Mwari webarika” Zvikanzi, “Ko, Iye Mwari webarika wacho…?” Zvikanzi, “Mwari waAbrahama naSoromoni na…” [Apostle and Congregation laugh—ED] Ndakati, “Iwe ukanyara kupupura zvauri, vana vako vachakunyadzisa. [Congregation says, ‘Amen.’] Even vayenzi vakauya, achatanga kutaura mwa…?” [Congregation says, “mwana.”] Ehe. Woti, “Hah, Eh.” Anongotanga kunamata vanhu varipo. [Congregation laughs—ED] “Mwari waApostori [Apostle claps once—ED] Gumbura, Mwari weBarika!” [Apostle claps once; Congregation laughs—ED]

entries.title: The Revelation prt 14
entries.text: Waona hama yako yongoti, “Heyi, mwana uyu…” [Apostle and Congregation laugh—ED] So, we are making things very difficult for everybody. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] But we are putting ourselves in a corner, yekuti tiite show our true identity. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Ehe and... Saka ngatinamatei. Friday ino izuva remunamato chai...? [Congregation says, “chairo,”] chairo. Hatiregerei kumbodzokera kumasure pamuteuro…? [Congregation says, “Amen.”] And you can never pray too …? [Congregation says, “too much,”] too much, handi’moona, ehe?

entries.title: The Revelation prt 14
entries.text: Saka mumwe nemumwe ngatizviisei pamberi paMwari. Ngatinamatirei vamwe vedu vari kufamba mangwana, vanosvika mangwana. Hativaisei pamberi paMwari. Hanzvadzi iyoyi ya… dzinenge dzapinda pamuedzo wakadai uyu, ndiSatani anenge ada kuparadza hupenyu hwemu…? [Congregation says, “hwemunhu, “] hwemunhu, handi’moona?

entries.title: The Revelation prt 14
entries.text: Zva Sister Boni, the devil has always desired her. [Congregation agrees—ED] Handi’moona kuti akamu desire? Kubva achiri pakati pedu vasati vadii… vabva, ha’moona? Saka vasati vabva ndiye akanga atomitiswa kudhara. The only thing that happened akabva a deliver mwana ndokufa kuChitungwiza hospital uko. Vachangobva pakati pedu handi’moona? Ende munhu akanga amumitisa anga ari mwana wemu—wevabereki vane chokuita nohun’anga. Handi’moona zvataigara tichitsvinyira?

entries.title: The Revelation prt 14
entries.text: Then still, eh baba vacho vazo realizer kuti ngatidzokerei kuChechi, still iye Boni ndiye anga aine more difficulty than that one. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Uyu aida kuwuya manje Simanga uyu. But Boni akanga asingadii…? [Congregation says, “asingadi,”] asingadi. Achirambira kwana sekuru vake uko. Inyaya dzevakomana futi. Ndokumbotiza ndokuenda kuBhuruwayo, kuna amai vababa. Ikoko kwaakanga achitreniwawo [being trained—ED] zvaakanga achitreniwawo ikoko, ha’moona?

entries.title: The Revelation prt 14
entries.text: Ndokuzoti pa’apaya adzoka... Ende achidzoka wainyatsoona kuti mwana ari ku suffer pakati pedu. Anga aine complex isingadii…? [Congregation says, “isingaite,”] isingaite! Wainyatsoona… aitadza kana kumira kana kutadza kutaura nevanhu. She felt rejected. Now, when the devil has realized that, that person has just been delivered, handi’moona Satani zvaanoita? [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Hm? We worked very hard for that girl to be what she is now. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Ndo’zvondirwadza chai…? [Congregation says, “chaizvo,”] chaizvo. She couldn’t talk. She couldn’t eat. She couldn’t even walk. Boni you had to be careful kutaura naye. Mukangoseka aitochema, kana kuenda akadai, [Apostle folds hands demonstrating—ED] aka—anga akanganisika, ha’maoona?

entries.title: The Revelation prt 14
entries.text: Then still ave pano, aive ne problem iye yekufunga kuti baba vanoda uyu kudarika i…? [Congregation says, “iye.”] “Baba vanoda Mai Nyaude. Vanoti iwe hauroorwe. Heh, wakazodai wakazodai. Baba havana basa neni. Havambondifoneri. Vanofonera Mai Nyaude. Heh, heh.”

entries.title: The Revelation prt 14
entries.text: Tha—that’s how she—she is. She’s very se…? [Congregation says, “sensitive,”] sensitive, handitika? Now, I know for sure if that that girl goes into the world, she’s definitely going to be possessed, nemweya yei…? [Congregation says, “yetsvina,”] yetsvina. Nature yake zvai…? [Congregation says, “zvairi,”] zvairi.

entries.title: The Revelation prt 14
entries.text: So, we are forced kuti titomudzora. The way we want—whether we like it or…? [Congregation says, “or not.”] Totongomuisa mumaoko aSatani. Kuti adii chete…? [Congregation says, “adzoke,”] …dzoke zvinhu zvirege kumufambira. Kumuregera ariko… I don’t just put everybody. Ha’moona vana Pau ndakavaregera vakaenda? I didn’t mind her going, really, to tell the honest truth.

entries.title: The Revelation prt 14
entries.text: I didn’t see the difference of where she went and when she was…? [Congregation says, “she was here.”] She was just living the sa…? [Congregation says, “the same,”] the same. It’s only that—that she came out into the open when she went there. But Boni patinenge tinavo kudai tinombova controller vana ava. Ta’atichifunga kuti Mwari anoti—anoita nyasha, handitika? Saka, nhasi Friday zvakare, ngatimuisei pamberi paMwari. [Congregation says, “Amen.”]

entries.title: The Revelation prt 14
entries.text: Then nyaya yedu yekutsvaka mari iyi, ndoda kuti—ndakambokuudzai kuti nyatsokumbira kuti, “Ndinokumbirawo mari.” [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Nokuti Mwari vakati, “Sirivhera nendarama ndeyani…?” [Congregation says, “ndeZvangu.”] “Ndokumbirawo chii?” [Congregation says, “mari, Amen.”] Don’t bit about the bush. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] “Ndiri kukumbirawo chii…? [Congregation says, ‘mari.’] Ehe. Mari yekuvaka chechi, ku supporter basa rani…? [Congregation says, ‘raMwari,’] raMwari, handi’maona? Kuvawo nechimiro chakanaka muMwe…? [Congregation says, ‘muMwenga,’] Mwenga. Ndiri kukumbirawo chii…? [Congregation says, ‘mari,’] mari.” [Congregation says, “Amen.”]

entries.title: The Revelation prt 14
entries.text: Be specific abou…? [Congregation says, “about it.”] Be specific about it. “Ndiri kukumbirawo mari. Ndodawo mari Ishe wangu. Ndodawo kupfuma. Ndodawo kugara zvakadii…? [Congregation says, ‘zvakanaka,’] zvakanaka.” Handi’moona, ehe?

entries.title: The Revelation prt 14
entries.text: And let’s pray, kuti tiroorane zvakanaka. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] There’s nothing that hurts me so much to see a brother handitika, very able-bodied young man, handitika, not being able to ma…? [Congregation says, “to marry.”] Ehe? Mweya yemayi…? [Congregation says, “yemadzinza.”] Mweya yemadzinza iyi, hah? People like vana Brother Opperman vangade vane dzimba dzavo. Vana Brother Patrick, vangade vane dzimba dzavo. Vana Brother Makono, ha’moona? Vangadei vaine dzimba dzavo, varoora vasikana.

entries.title: The Revelation prt 14
entries.text: Ende, ma brother echidiki aya; vana Chibvura, vana Nyathi, vangade vaane madzimai echipi…? [Congregation says, “echipiri,”] echipiri. [Brother Nyathi says, “that’s right. Amen.”] Handi’mukuzviona? [Congregation laughs—ED] But you can see, chiri kutadzisa izvi ichii...? [Congregation says, “imari,”] ihomwe. Kuita mukadzi one, chiri kukutadza kuroora mukadzi one ihomwe. Kuita vakadzi vaviri futi iho…? [Congregation says, “ihomwe,”] ihomwe, ha’moona?

entries.title: The Revelation prt 14
entries.text: I’ll be the happiest person, when I see youngsters vanenge vakaita sana Nyathi ava, vachiuya paChechi panapa aine dzimba dzake mbi…? [Congregation says, “mbiri.”] Kumwe kune vana vatatu, kumwe kune vana vaviri. Inini I believe what I preach, [Congregation says, “Amen,”] and I’m not… apologetic, as far as polygamy is co...? [Congregation says, “concerned.”] No, ha’moona?

entries.title: The Revelation prt 14
entries.text: Vese vapfanha vari kutambura nekushaiwa mari ava, vana Brother Edmore ava, vana Brother Hokonya ava, ha’moona? Imari ka iyi? Ehe vana Brother Shepherd ava. Dai yanga iripo brother, imagine Shepherd aine mhuri dzake, tichinyatsoratidza chinonzi bari…? [Congregation says, “barika.”] Uchiuya paChechi nemotokari, nemadzimai ani…? [Congregation says, “ako,”] ako.

entries.title: The Revelation prt 14
entries.text: Heyi chinozorwadza chacho worse manje, madzimai acho ari…? [Congregation says, “aripo.”] Vakanaka! And this what hurts me most. The longer they stay, the more they run away. [Congregation says, “Amen.”]

entries.title: The Revelation prt 14
entries.text: Izvozvi munofunga kuti Boni ari kumba kuna baba namai? Akaonekwa nechimwe chimuchinda. Aone atsvukira mwana uya, because ukauya pano unenge wakanakaka. Ukauya panapa… Tarirai zvavanoita kunaka kwavanoita? [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Mukazomuona Boni after a yuziwa [used—ED] nemuchinda wemunyika iyeye, you won’t like her. [Congregation says, “Amen.”]

entries.title: The Revelation prt 14
entries.text: But akasangana naye kuChitungwiza muchinda uyu. Aone mwana ganda rake zvaradii...? [Congregation says, “zvaraita,”] zvaraita. Chimwana chatsvukira chanaka, apa murume hachi... ? [Congregation says, “hachina.”] But chiri hyper passion. Vamwe vasikanaka ava kunyaraka ava? Munongofunga kuti hyper passion iri kuvarume chete? Hah, mucharooraka ndopamuchaona, [Congregation laughs—ED] kuti iri kwe…? [Congregation says, “kwese.”]

entries.title: The Revelation prt 14
entries.text: Kune mamwe ma sisters anoda sexual fellowship zvakanya…? [Congregation says, “zvakanyanya,”] zvakanyanya. Vanototaura, kunyanya vanenge vandijaira vandinogara navo pano kuti, “Ahh ini handizvigone ini pastor zvekugara ndoga ini. Hah ini ndodawo murume wangu ini pastor ini. Hah ini handizvigone ini.” Vanotonditaura, handingavataure hangu nemazita [Congregation laughs—ED; 15:46 inaudible.] But vanogara vachindidii... Havambovanzi hah, kutaura open. “Inondinetsa nyama ini inondinetsa.” [Apostle and Congregation laugh—ED]

entries.title: The Revelation prt 14
entries.text: Otoziva kuti hah, zvechokwadi mwana wachema chema handitika? Eh, anodawo murume wani…? [Congregation says, “wake,”] wake handi’moona ehe? Anenge achidawo murume wake. They all want to be married these sisters. Kunyanya kana vava above twenty-five.

entries.title: The Revelation prt 14
entries.text: Ezvino nda’ndichiona… kuri kuuya—kwauya munin’ina wa Sister Amadeus uyu, eh anonzi, Amabel wacho. Akuita mwana wechita...? [Congregation says, “wechitatu.”] That’s when you realize kuti vana avaka, vane ma mistakes avo but vanodii...? [Congregation says, “vanonamata,”] vanonamata. Havaite vakomana. Havamitiswi. Heh, ha’moona? Vana Sister Chipo ava, ma thirty-one ka aya, eh? Tinongovakwesha hedu kuti, “Kuputsa chirongo wasvika,” but havana chirongo chavaputsa vana ava.

entries.title: The Revelation prt 14
entries.text: Thirty-one years for a girl aita course yake yehu te… [Congregation says, “teacher.”] Woenda kumurume wachowo, chakurova kuma thirty chakutiwo uko. Handi’moona kuti vanhu vakuru chaizvo? [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Munyika it’s unheard of. What you see happening paChechi panapa it’s literally a miracle. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Imiracle [It’s a miracle—ED] chai…? [Congregation says, “chaiyo,”] chaiyo. Handi’maona? Saka unenge wakushuvira kuti, “Aah, dai vanhu ava vagara zvakadii…? [Congregation says, “zvakanaka.”] Eh? Tangoramba tangova ma, “…Written epistles...” [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Ha’maona eh? Tava nedzimba dzedu. Toomeserwa nenyaya yemari? Aah aah. “Gugudza unodii..? [Congregation says, ‘unozarurirwa,’; Apostle knocks on pulpit several times.] tsvaka unoita sei? [Congregation says, ‘unowana,’] kumbira unodii…?” [Congregation says, “unopiwa.”] Hanzi, “Regai munhu wese ave murevi wei…?” [Congregation says, “wenhema.”]

entries.title: The Revelation prt 14
entries.text: Vana Amadeus ava vangade vatova nevana ava. Vanin’ina vake vese varoogwa. Agatha ane vana. Iye Amabel akuita mwana wechitatu, iye haana. Ha’moona? Tarirai vana Sister Aletta ava. Vakuraka vasi—vana sister ava. Ende ngavanake vana ava. Ukamutuma ku Greencroft haambosvikiko asina kunyengwa. Kuenda kunyengwa, kudzoka kudii... Ende vagara vana vokunamata vari magnetic. Vakangonaka, whether masvika kana pari kuitwa ma ceremony, ivo vanenge vari outstanding. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Hamheno zvinenge zviri pavanhu vanodii...? [Congregation says, “vanonamata,”] vanonamata. They are very appealing, ha’moona? Zvekuti nyika inonyatsoona kuti type yevanhu ava hatichaidii…? [Congregation says, “hatichaiwani.”]

entries.title: The Revelation prt 14
entries.text: Vanotovabvunza kuti, “Munogara muno? Hah, kupi ikoko?” Nekunaka kwavanenge vakaita. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Apa manje imi muripo, mari hamu… ? [Apostle claps once—ED; Congregation says, “hamuna.”] Toda kuti ma brother anamate, titsuure mweya yemadzinza. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Mweya yeurombo idii…? [Congregation says, “ipere,”] ipere! Honaiwo imimi vacho maku weakener. Makumitisa vakadzi vane midzimu, vakadzi vanoroya, vakadzi vanogeza nemishonga, heh? Vanasikana vane mazita. Mahure ekuti hautomboziva kuti varume vaakarara navo va…? [Congregation says, “vangani?”] Hah? Unoroora musikana akapedzesera kurara nemurume nezuro? Handi’moona kuti it’s an insult? Iwe uchinobvisa mari, iye akararwa mahara last week, heh? Vana vaMwari?

entries.title: The Revelation prt 14
entries.text: Yasvika nguva yekuti tinyatsotaura nedenga redenga …?... [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Mwari ngavatidaire! [Congregation says, “Amen.”] “Gugudza unodii…? [Apostle knocks on pulpit four times—ED; Congregation says, ‘unozarurirwa,’] tsvaka unoita sei…?” [Congregation says, “unowana,”] eh. Ende, I don’t believe in Zimbabwe, right now, as we are talking right now, there are any better young men than you find here. I will be surprised to tell the honest truth, if they are any better young men, than you get here. And if there are any better young girls than you get here. I think the cream of Christianity in Zimbabwe iri panapa. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Inini ndo’zvandinototenda nemwoyo wangu wese. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] If I thought otherwise, I would go where I think they are.

entries.title: The Revelation prt 14
entries.text: But ndiri kukutaurirai chokwadi. Whether muri kuenda ku Christ Embassy, whether muri kuenda ku Emmanuel Centre, whether muri kuenda kuchechi dzemu Message, hamumbowani quality yevanhu vamunowana pa…? [Congregation says, “pano,”] panapa. This is not bragging, ha’moona? It’s a fact. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Vapfanha vatinavo vanonamata! [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Mukaona kutsungirira kwakaita vakomana vedu, kana vapfanha vatinavo vana Giveous, vakuraka vakomana vaya. KuMaenga kuya, vana Jabu ava. Vakangomira nekuna…? [Congregation says, “kunamata.”] You rarely get people like that on earth. Not now, mu Laodicea, hah aah. You can’t get them.

entries.title: The Revelation prt 14
entries.text: Ndopaunoona kuti vana ava, pane chakaitika kwavari. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Mwari akataura nani…? [Congregation says, “navo,”] navo. Vanhu vakapona ava. Ndo the same nekuvasikana vacho, vasikana vakanaka. They get exposure vashanyira hama dzavo, but they never give in. Pano ndinotenda kuti pane vana vakapona. [Congregation says, “Amen.”]

entries.title: The Revelation prt 14
entries.text: Ndoozvichizooma manje munhu akatanga [Apostle claps hands once—ED] kutambira ma text kuvakomana vemunyika. You feel very… bad. You have one option. Ukangotanga kuita secret communication nemukomana womunyika, you—you stick out like this. Unotanga ku feeler kuti, “Mmm.” Ende zvinombotora nguva here ukatanga kutaura nevakomana vomunyika. Tinongoona nguva yaunotenderera pa yard iyo ino iyi, uri pa phone uri kure neva…? [Congregation says, “nevamwe.”] Totoziva kuti, “Ohh.” The moment yaunotanga kunamata zvakanaka, nyaya yema phone inopera kuti hwava! [Congregation says, “Amen.”]

entries.title: The Revelation prt 14
entries.text: Vanoziva zvandiri kutaura vanhu vese vari pano. Usati wa’akunamata zvakanaka pafoni [as in phone—ED] haudii…? [Congregation says, “haubve.”] Ende unenge uchingotiza vamwe. Anenge achitaura ari kuseri uko. Unomuona ari kumiti iyo. Hm? Handi’muri kuzviona? Munhu wese kana aiti akadaira foni anobuda mumota maari, taiona mota dzakamira kubva pano kusvika kutawundi. But normal conversation inongotaurwa vanhu vari…? [Congregation says, “varipo.”] Ehe. “Ndimaiguru?” “Ehe.” “Aiwa, mafuta aya ndamasiya paya.” “Hongu.” “Ehe, ndakutosvika mutawundi, ehe!”

entries.title: The Revelation prt 14
entries.text: But ukaona umwe achiti “Mmm, mm-hm, mmm.” [Congregation laughs—ED] Aah! Oziva kuti haasi kugona kudaira zvaari kudii…? [Congregation says, “zvaari kubvunzwa.”] Haadi kuti vamwe vadii...? [Congregation says, “vanzwe.”] Wazonzwa, “Just hold on, eh nda’ndichimbotaura pafoni.” [Apostle demonstrating—ED] Makambozviona kwaani? Heh?

entries.title: The Revelation prt 14
entries.text: Foni [as in phones—ED] dzaigara dzakadzimikirwa mumba pa corner padzinogara. Wa—dzakagara dzisingabude foni, heh? Dzakazotanga rinhi kuti kana vanhu votaura vanomhanya kuenda uko? Waingoti ukafonerwa mumba mauri uri imomomo, wotopedza ugere ipapo haina kwayaienda. Waiidzura? [Congregation laughs—ED] Saka izvi zvakazotanga rinhi, zvokuti munhu unomuona achimanya, kutenderera ma yard yose? Wotoziva kuti, “No—no—no—no—no.” Twunhu twakaunza naughtiness utwu. [Congregation says, “mm.”]

entries.title: The Revelation prt 14
entries.text: Ndosaka kana uine musikana waunoda zveshuwa ukaona aita foni iti, “Maiweee.” [Congregation laughs—ED] Woisa muteuro handiti? [Apostle laughs—ED] Ukarega kuisa muteuro… Boni akasiirwa foni nababa vake, ndopakaita communication iyi. Ifoni iyi.

entries.title: The Revelation prt 14
entries.text: But I wouldn’t want to take away phones from the Bride of Jesus Christ. [Congregation says, “Amen,”] nokuti Mwengaka, uri very respo…? [Congregation says, “responsible.”] Ende zvinhu zvakanaka fani izvi. If it wasn’t poverty, I would buy a phone for e…? [Congregation says, “everyone,”] for everyone. Even in case of emergency, unogona kufona, “Ndinamatireiwo, ndiri pakadii...? [Congregation says, “pakaoma, “] pakaoma.” “Huyai muzonditora, ndasvika pakati.” [Congregation says, “Amen.”]

entries.title: The Revelation prt 14
entries.text: But ikapinda mu wrong ha…? [Congregation says, “hands,”] hands. So, let’s not blame technology, let’s blame the user. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Ha’moona? Kana ikapuhwa sister vasina mweya wakadii…? [Congregation says, “wakanaka.”] Ehe, vanofuga musoro vari mupiro, ha’moona?

entries.title: The Revelation prt 14
entries.text: Pane mamwe ma text ari mu phone idzi, ekuti kana text yacho irimo, haufanire kupinda nayo muyii… muChechi, nekuti Mwari Vari kuiverenga izvozvi iri muhomwe yako iwewe. [Congregation laughs—ED] Iyoyo text iyoyo, Vari kuiona iripo. Yawanyora zvisingadii…? [Congregation says, “zvisingaite.”] Ungava mutsvene? Umu muhomwe mune zvakawora umu. Zvingaite izvozvo? Hm? Inenge iri hlamba isingaite iri mu handbag, yakabatana ne hymn book neBhaibheri racho ku side uku. [Congregation laughs—ED] Ha’moona kuti hazvienderani? [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Ehe. Munhu anonamata izvozvo haaite izvozvo. [Congregation says, “Amen.”]

entries.title: The Revelation prt 14
entries.text: Ngamuve nemashoko ekuti, “Shamwari verenga VaHebhuru.” “Ehe, shamwari verenga Mateyo.” “Ehe, wakainzwa here Message yatakaparidzirwa Svondo yakapera?” “Ko han—hama uripi?” Handitika? Ehh, “Handisi kukunzwa, uri kumbondirangarirawo here mumuteuro?’’ ‘‘Shamwari I want to share you with this that thought I have.”

entries.title: The Revelation prt 14
entries.text: Ngadziza… Sekuzara kunoita vahedheni nefoni dzehlamba, dzedu ngadzizarewo nohutsve…? [Congregation says, “nohutsvene, Amen.”] Hm? Ifoni yekuti munhu achinhonga, anotaura woga kuti, “Foni iyi yaraswa nemuKri…?” [Congregation says, “nemuKristu.”] “Huya uone shamwari, munhu uyu ukagara une foni yake unotendeuka. Mutsvage umudzorere foni yake.” Inenge yakangonyorwa maGwaro che…? [Congregation says, “chete.”]

entries.title: The Revelation prt 14
entries.text: Zvino dziripo dzimwe foni dzokuti ikango—ikanhongwa ikauya ichibvunzwa pano unoiramba muridzi wayo. [Congregation laughs—ED] Kunzi, “Inenge yenyu sister.” ..?... “Aah, haizi yangu!” Because unonyatsoziva kuti—kuti munhu uyu andizive kuti ndiri muchechi nezvanga zviri mufo…? [Congregation says, “mufoni.”] Ngativei vana vaMwari chaivo. [Congregation says, “Amen.”]

entries.title: The Revelation prt 14
entries.text: Ndosaka ini ndichitenda kuti panapa tinonamata, ini ndinotenda kudaro. Tikatsuura mweya yetsvina inoenda! [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Tikatsuura hurombo hunodii…? [Congregation says, “hunoenda.”] Convention Centre tichava…? [Congregation says, “tichavaka.”] MuKadoma chechi tichadii…? [Congregation says, “tichavaka.”] MuKwekwe tinope…? [Congregation says, “tinopedza.”] Nokuti Mwari vanesu! [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Mwari vanotinzwa! [Congregation says, “Amen.”]

entries.title: The Revelation prt 14
entries.text: Ha’moona? Ndosaka iwewe mwana waMwari handitika, hatipindei pakunamata. Hatiregerei kujairira kunamata. Tikarega kujairira kunamata, Mwari anotiitira nyasha, handi’moona? [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Ine iri nyaya yekuti unenge uri munhu uya wekuti unenge uchitamba nevakomana, ende unopedzesera woda kunzvenga vamwe vako. Unopedzesera woda kunzvenga vamwe, kuti vasazive kuti uri…? [Congregation says, “uripi,”] uripi. Mutendi, presence yake ngaizi…? [Congregation says, “ngaizikanwe.”]

entries.title: The Revelation prt 14
entries.text: There’s nothing that you do, underhand. Heh? Ukaenda ku town tizivise. Ende wanzofambawo neva…? [Congregation says, “nevamwe.”] Brother tora vamwe! Hm? Tora vamwe brother mufambe mose. Kana uchida kufamba nemusikana wako Saturday, muchinotenga ice-cream hapana chakashata, muri mu courtship, handitika? But torawo vamwe bro…? [Congregation says, “brother,”] brother mofambawo makadaro. Ehe, muchifara muchisununguka kuti ungozvichengeta, ha’moona?

entries.title: The Revelation prt 14
entries.text: Remekedza Mwari panheyo yemusha waunovaka. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Amen! [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Remekedza Mwari panheyo yemusha waunovaka. Musha waunovaka ngauvakwe panheyo dzaMwari! [Congregation says, “Amen.”] “Be ye not unequally yoked together with u…? [Congregation says, “unbelievers, Amen.”]

entries.title: The Revelation prt 14
entries.text: Zvo’ ndifunge kuti chokwadi vana ava, ufunge kuti unzwe kana kuti Patie watorwa nemukomana wemunyika ari kuita Lab tech, Tichaona asina. Does that make sense? [Congregation says, “no.”] Hah? Enoch haana, handiti? But Caro woenda, neumwe munhu. Mukuona zvimwe zvinhu zviri ni—zvi …?... It’s cruelty. [Congregation says, “Amen.”]

entries.title: The Revelation prt 14
entries.text: Kana Boni chokwadi akatizira mukomana womunyika, haaah? He did not only betray God; he betrayed every single brother. [Apostle Gumbura laughs—ED] Every single brother ungade …?... —mukangovaona motovanyenga. [Congregation laughs—ED] Haikona kumboti, “Ini ndaikudaika inini? Ndaikudai inini. Ini ndonamata. Huya, huya.” [Apostle laughs—ED] Haikona kumboti—ibvawaf—ita ma funny, handiti, ehe? Kuti, “Aiwa brother.” Woti, “Aiwa ndaitokudai ndini. Ndini ndaikudai munhu wa—hanzadzi yangu kani. Hanzvadzi usaende kuvahedheni?” [Apostle imitates crying; Congregation laughs—ED]

entries.title: The Revelation prt 14
entries.text: Vanenge vari varume varefu vakaita sana Opa vachichema. [Congregation laughs—ED] Opa ha’moona eh? Anofanira kumisa motikari, kana vana Witness Makono ava. Kuti, “Ko, hanzvadzi ndochii ichocho? Hindava usina kundio…?... Ndotora vanhu veJoni here hanzvadzi, hah?” [ 27:45- 27:56 inaudible, Congregation laughs—ED]

entries.title: The Revelation prt 14
entries.text: Hanzva… Hama ngadzichengete vasikana vavo hama. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Ehe, ma brother kwawo, anochengeta vasikana vaani…? [Congregation says, “vavo.”] Ehe, ndafara na brother—ma brother—vana—ma Lab tech aya. Sister Patie ava, va—vakandi textira, Brother Tichaona zvikanzi, “Pa—Pa—Pastor, toda kuti timbogara pasi mutibatsirewo. Tiri kunetsana nema sister kunoku.” Ndikati, “Hindava?” Zvikanzi, “Aah Pastor, kunyanya Sister Patie ava. …?... Iye zvino Saturday.”

entries.title: The Revelation prt 14
entries.text: Ndikati, “Huyai—huyai—huyai mundiuze nyaya yenyu.” Ndobva vauya. Ndikati, “Nyaya ndeyei?” Zvikanzi, “Zvakaitika ngava…” Vaka—vakapinda mu lesson Sister Patie ava, thirty minutes late and nobody knew where she was, handi’moona manje? Ma brother akati, “Hau! Ko ma’a muripi?” Va’akubvunza Sister Patie.

entries.title: The Revelation prt 14
entries.text: Zvikanzi na Sister Patie, “Muri kundishungurudza mwoyo wangu. Muri vananiko imi munondibvunza zvamondibvunza izvozvo?” Ndobva dzasimuka ndobva dzadii…? [Congregation says, “dzaenda.”] Handi’moona kuti zviri wrong? [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Yet Tichaona ndi brother vakuru. Vari kutora responsibility yabhudhi, [Congregation says, “Amen,”] kuhanzvadzi yaani…? [Congregation says, “yavo, Amen.”] Hah?

entries.title: The Revelation prt 14
entries.text: Yet, chionai manje nyaya yacho tochibvunza. “Ko, imimi makaenderei kwakanga kusina vamwe?” Zvikanzi, “Ndaka…” Akaenda akanoudza Caro naRunya kuti, “Ndiri kuenda ku classroom.” Handi’moona zvaakataura? A’akuenda ku classroom, ndobva azofunga kuti ku classroom kunema—kune noise, ndokuenda ku ground. But paakaenda ku ground haana waakadii…? [Congregation says, “waakaudza.”] Innocent? Innocent? [Congregation laughs—ED] But handi’moona kuti vanhu vaMwari vari alert ka ava? [Congregation says, “Amen.”]

entries.title: The Revelation prt 14
entries.text: Heh? Those—those brothers are alert; they could put one and one toge…? [Congregation says, “together.”] Moreso, vozobvunzwa oramba kudii…? [Congregation says, “kutaura.”] Ndikati, “Ko sister, makaudza vamwe kuti muri kuenda ku classroom. Ndobva mazofunga mava moga kuti classroom hakuchadii…? [Congregation says, ‘hakuchaite.’] Why didn’t you go back, kunoudza vamwe kuti kana mukange mandishaya mu classroom, ndazofunga kuti ku classroom kune noise, nda’akuenda ku grou…?” [Congregation says, “ku ground.”]

entries.title: The Revelation prt 14
entries.text: Vaida kuenda ku ground, kuitira kuti kana kune muchinda wemunyika ari kuwirirana nani…? [Congregation says, “navo,”] navo, anozosvika iko…? [Congregation says, “ikoko.”] Aiwa, ndiri kungofungawo. [Congregation laughs—ED] Handizvo here varanda vaMwari? [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Ehe, handizvo? Hatitauriranei chokwadi, ehe? Ndikati, “Sister, chitaura…” Ndavati ava hanzvadzi, “Hatikumanikidzii kutendeuka, asi kana Mwari akupai chii…? [Congregation says, ‘nyasha,’] chokwadi chichadii…?” [Congregation says, “chichabuda.”]

entries.title: The Revelation prt 14
entries.text: She cheated other girls kuti, “Ndiri kuenda ku classroom.” She never went there. Ndozofunga aoga kuti, “Rega ndiende ku ground.” Heh? Saka ndazovati, “Sister taurai chokwadi. Ma— hakuna akasvika ku ground ikoko?” Zvikanzi, “Hakuna.” But imi mofunga kuti hakuna? Joze akatosvika ikoko, akati, “Hesi Patie. Ko ndeipi yako?” Zvikanzi, “Iwe Joze handisikuda zvekutaura newe.” Iye achiziva hake kuti ndiye waavinga ikoko [Congregation laughs—ED] kuti aone…. “Iwe Joze iwe, ndakakuudza kuti ndoenda kuchechi ndonamata.” [Congregation laughs—ED] Mukuona zvoita vasikana? Ndo game yenyu, tinoiziva. Anonzi, malambodilila, [Congregation laughs—ED] kana musingaazive.

entries.title: The Revelation prt 14
entries.text: Ehe, ndiwo anonzi, malambodilila iwayo. Saka inzwa, ndozvandinofunga kuti hanzvadzi. [Apostle chuckles—ED] Hanzvadzi ndozvainofanira kuva yakaita musi uyu. Yaigonzvenga vamwe sei? Handi’moona? Ende yorega kutsanangurira hama, handiti?

entries.title: The Revelation prt 14
entries.text: Ende ndakashora Boni uyu, eh kutiza kwake kwaakaita, ma sister akaenda naye nemusi wechii…? Patakaenda tichienda ku graduation yema Lab tech, ndopaakasangana nemukomana waakatizira uyu. The girl spoke for forty-five minutes nemukomana waaiziva. Moziva kuti Boni maaiitira misikanzwa muChitu…? [Congregation says, “muChitungwiza.”] Forty-five minutes! Vamwe ma sisters aakaenda nawo kana ku…

entries.title: The Revelation prt 14
entries.text: Isu toziva kuti kana ukaona mumwe musikana achitaura nemukomana, unosvika ipapo. Ende sister vaya ngavakurumidze kuita introdu…? [Congregation says, “introduction.”] Handi’ndozvatinoziva? [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Even ukaona brother vachitaura nemusika…? [Congregation says, “nemusikana.”] Svika umire mire eh, uchingotarisa zviri funny kudai. Ukaona aramba …?... kana ari bhururu wako iti, “What? [Congregation laughs—ED] Surely this can’t be the end of the conversation. Titsanangurire kuti wauri kutaura naye ndi…? [Congregation says, ‘ndiyani, Amen.’] Ndiani?”

entries.title: The Revelation prt 14
entries.text: Vakamuregera. Kureva kuti, Boni uya ataura, ataura, ataura, kwakuchiendesa Precious. Precious ozosvika ikoko va’akutanga kubvunzana manje kuti, “Ko, zvi—zvi…” Vanhu vataura fourty-five minutes, va’akutanga kutaura zvinobvunzana vanhu vachitanga kuonana. Saka vanga vakurasisa ani? Vanga vakurasisa Pee, ha’moona? But those sisters, they should have come here handitika? [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Immediately vangade vakandidii…? [Congregation says, “vakataura.”] Zvaiita vana Tichaona izvi. Tichaona akabva a texter ipa…? [Congregation says, “ipapo.”] Vanochengetana vanhu ava, haikona zvekutamba.

entries.title: The Revelation prt 14
entries.text: Pane nguva yakataura Brother Tanatsirwa chaivo chaivo naWedze uyu, husiku kuma ten akangomira pa door kudaiwo mu room yaWedze, handitika? Manheru iwayo vachitaura. Zvikanzi, “Munhu waMwari izvozvi vari kutaura soo todii…?” Ndikati, “Endai ipapo munoti, ‘Munhu waMwari kutaura kwaka…? [Congregation says, ‘kwakwana,’] kwakwana.’” Muramu wakeka uyu, heh? Ende muchinda wadhonza. [Congregation laughs—ED] Ha’moona kunonzi kuchengetana? [Congregation says, “Amen.”]

entries.title: The Revelation prt 14
entries.text: Ndikati, “Chiendai ipapa hama, muende munobvunzunyura zviri kuitwa ipapo. Endai munobvunzunyura pachiri pai…?” [Apostle and Congregation say, “padhuze.”] Hama ndobva yauya. Ndikati, “Brother Tanatsiwa, siyanai nekutaura nemuramu kuchikoro uko kuma ten dzehusi…” [Apostle and Congregation say, “dzehusiku.”] Ha’moona zvinoita nyasha? [Congregation says, “Amen.”]

entries.title: The Revelation prt 14
entries.text: Vanhu ndevekuchengetana. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Mukuona kuti ma brother aya, ma—ma Lab tech ari alert ka aya? [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Even Kudzai asati awa, was very alert. Pakatora Wedze journey, akaenda ku—kuHwahwa uku. Ari mu road ndaka’a ndato textirwa, “Pastor ndataura naye kuti asaende. Musikana ane nharo uyu.” Mukarangarira ndakakwesha Wedze chaizvo nenyaya iyoyo.

entries.title: The Revelation prt 14
entries.text: But manje after Boni aita izvi, nobody told me, nobody. Auya pano, vanhu va’akutaura kuti Boni anga asingabve pai…? Va’akutaura manje. You see how insulting that is? [Congregation says, “mm.”] Anga asingabve pafoni. Aingobuda otenderera. Ende anomuka kuseni, amuka kuseni opinda mu toilet okiya door, otaura pafo… Va’akutaura iye zvino. Now, [Apostle claps once—ED] ndokunonzi kuyeuka bako wadii…? [Congregation says, “waniwa.”] Musi waatiza, Busie akamuona. Hanzi, “Ndangoti ari kuenda muchechi kunonamata.”

entries.title: The Revelation prt 14
entries.text: Ishuwa iyoyo? Muri kuona kuti vasikana vamazuvano havachengetani? Heh? Akatomuona achipfeka… Wakamboona munhu achienda muchechi kunonamata achichena? Kuseni achirova hembe yakachena, kuenda kunonamata? Handi’ munhu unonamata wapfeka zvawamuka unazvo? Wozodzokera wonogeza wochena? She knew it, kuti munhu ari kuenda uyu. She didn’t want to come out in the open. Ndosaka ndakazomushaudha. Iye haana… A—akafunga kuti ndamushaudhira izvozvi. Ndamuti, “Iwe huya ugadzire…” Zvikanzi, “Ndiri pa duty.”

entries.title: The Revelation prt 14
entries.text: Ndikamushaudha. Ndikati, “Zibenzi romunhu! Kana uchida kutevera Boni, utevere! Mofunga kuti handizvizive kuti uri ndururani.” Ndaimutukira suspicion yanda’andina… [Congregation says, “ndinayo,”] kuti she knew, ha’moona?

entries.title: The Revelation prt 14
entries.text: Vanonyarara vasikana vachivigana. Ukaona umwe achinyarara umwe atanga kudaro. Zvino chindiudzai kuti, wagona here kuti Boni nhasi aende mumaoko emunhu womunyi…? [Congregation says, “womunyika.”] Wagona? God is going to put marks in your life, for allowing Boni, heh, kuti aende mumaoko emukomana womunyika? And that mukomana womunyika achamuchengeta zvakanaka? Hah? Kana asina kutizira mukomana womunyika, how long is that young girl going to survive out there asina mukomana wemuyii…? [Congregation says, “wemunyika.”] How long? Hm?

entries.title: The Revelation prt 14
entries.text: Vanhu vanonamata vanobatsirana! [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Munochengetana pache…? [Congregation says, “pachenyu,”] pachenyu. Ende ma brother edu izvozvo izvo vanozviita. Ndinotoziva zvakanaka naka ma brother unoona achitaurira, “Pastor ndaona brother nhingi. Ndaudzwa nyaya yakati yakati, brother nhingi.”

entries.title: The Revelation prt 14
entries.text: Nde’endichitoziva zvangu vari panapa kuti brother ava, vari kudanana nemusikana wekune imwe college. Musikana wacho anenge akataurira brother kuti, “Mukomana wangu.” Asi ivo kuChechi vachidii…? [Congregation says, “vachiuya.”] Unozoona hupenyu hwavo haufa…? [Congregation says, “haufambe.”] Hauroore. Haudiwe na sister. Hau-impruvhe [to improve—ED] hupenyu hwako. “…A double minded man can never receive anything, [Congregation says, ‘Amen,’] from the …?!” [Congregation says, “the Lord.”]

entries.title: The Revelation prt 14
entries.text: Vanhu ndovanobatsirana, [Congregation says, “Amen,”] ha’moona? Ndosaka mukatoona… tinorasikirwa naye uyu, sekutamba uyu. Pakatanga Chichaya kuita musikanzwa, ma sister akatanga kutaura vana bro—vana Sister Hazvi vese ava. “Pastor anogara ari mu room dzevasikana. Pastor a’akuda kuita room yake yoga. Pastor kune musikana wokuChitungwiza ari kupinda imomo.” The alarm came. Taitozviziva kuti murume wa’akudii uyu…? Wa’akufa uyu.

entries.title: The Revelation prt 14
entries.text: But zva Boni, I blame the girls who stay here. Vese I blame them, ha’moona? Kwakuenda naye kuChitungwiza. Isu takakanga tabvaka. Ndokusiya brother vachipedzisa kutora ma picture, Brother Kakunga. Vanga zvizivewo izvozvo? Va’a vari busy kutora video yehama, handitika? Ma sister ah akati, “Aah. Mufundisi wadii… waenda wadzokera. Brother variku concentration. Aah? Mafoni achipihwa, mafoni achipihwa.”

entries.title: The Revelation prt 14
entries.text: Boni haana kuzouya akaita one week after that. Honai kupera kwavari kuita manje? Fadzi gone, Brother Wayne hwava! Muona zvakaitika? Hah? Dai takachengeta Fadzi zvakanaka, handi’muri kuzviona? Way angade ane mukadzi izvozvi. Kakura kamupfanha kaya but kwakutotsvaga panyowani. Fadzi tichamuwana?

entries.title: The Revelation prt 14
entries.text: Gone. Tsitsi Zhou, ndakashuva kuti dai ndakatora hangu pandakapuhwa paya. [Congregation laughs—ED] Pandakapuhwa dai ndakatora. [Apostle chuckles—ED] Ihwo hwakare kuita Mwarizve uhwu. Handiti? Ehe. Ndakati regai ndiite huMwari ndisiire vapfanha. [Apostle laughs—ED] Zvino vapfanha vakamuregera achidii…? [Apostle coughs—ED] VaNehohwa vakangomuka kuseni asi…? [Apostle claps once—ED; Congregation says, “asipo.”]

entries.title: The Revelation prt 14
entries.text: Zvino ipapa manje kurwadziwa kwaunoita. Unenge wakatora Boni, [Apostle claps once—ED] iii… Simanga, [Apostle claps once—ED] baba vake [Apostle claps once—ED] kuvapa imba, [Apostle claps once—ED] kuvayambutsa kuti vadzoke zvakare kunoita normal, handitika? Uchivachengeta iwewe, heh? Kuti, “Garai mahara munhu waMwari, chikafu tinokudii…? [Congregation says, ‘tinokupai.’] Tinokuchengetai garai chete, zvamadzoka ku Chechi ndonyaya ho…?” [Congregation says, “hombe.”]

entries.title: The Revelation prt 14
entries.text: At the end of the day, [Apostle claps once—ED] we lose one, [Apostle claps once—ED] heh? This is bad businessman-ship, ha’moona? Any businessman shouldn’t want that. It’s a big loss on our…? [Congregation says, “side,”] on our part. Very big loss. Ukazvifunga ipapo uchifunga pandakatora VaMhlanga, vachitanga kudzoka nevana vavo ava, woenda wonova kriyetera [to create—ED] room kuyii... kuHighfiridzi. Handina chandaiwana ini. Toona uyu aroorwa, iye—iye Boni tomuunza pano, kuchengeta inini personally. Kusvika atanga kuita nourished zvakanaka naka naka naka. Only kungomutora vakomana, kumuisa mudhimoni? Mumaoko emudzimu? Heh?

entries.title: The Revelation prt 14
entries.text: Aah! Unorara wakasvunura kuti, “Vakomanaka?” Unotanga kutarisa ivo vasara ivavo kuti, “Hah?” Zvino ndovigirwa futi ya Patie, achienda ku ground ari one, kusina mumwe munhu anodii… Ndifunge kwatabva na Patie iye zvino a’aku qualifier kuita Rebhu tech. Tongomusiya ari mumaoko ovamwe dhokotera mu... heh—heh mhemba inorova makuva? Mumwe munamato unodiwa manheru anhasi. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Zvinhu zvakadai ngatizvitsuurei zvacho…? [Congregation says, “zvachose, Amen.”]

entries.title: The Revelation prt 14
entries.text: Murume akadzokera ari nani. Tinongoti ndiye waruza. Uchanodyisa kwaadii…? [Congregation says, “kwaaenda.”] But mukaona marasikirwa ne one of these girls, isusu varume ndisu tadii…? [Congregation says, “taruza.”] It will be better dai anga ari wechi eight kana kwandiri. Kana wechi ten, pane kuti aende mumaoko emunhu womui…? [Congregation says, “womunyika.”] Agomuzvarira va...? [Congregation says, “vana.”] Munhu asina AIDS. Isu tikaenda ikoko tinonowana vasina, AIDS? Isu tikati rega tinokutoreraiwo mukutitorera vedu tinofa tese, heh? Isu tochengeta vedu zvakanaka naka. Kuvapa chikafu, kuvapa hembe, kuvachengeta zvese kungonoti mu… kujamba waya.

entries.title: The Revelation prt 14
entries.text: Musi waatiza chikomana chacho changa chitori panze apa. Ma brother akadii…? [Apostle illustrates Brothers sleeping; Congregation laughs—ED] Hanzvadzi ichidii…? [Congregation says, “ichiyenda.”] Ehe, ivo vakarara zvavo vanhu vaMwari, vanga vakaneta, vana Brother Edger vanga vakarara. Haa-aa. [Apostle makes sound like snoring—ED] Hapana akamuona, heh? But panochengetwa pano, handitika? But nobody saw her!

entries.title: The Revelation prt 14
entries.text: Mwari ngaatiitire nyasha manheru anhasi, [Congregation says, “Amen,”] ha’moona? Munhu wese ngaachengete ma sister edu aya. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] These are our sisters; they are our wives. If this Church is going to have children, that’s where the children are going to come…? [Congregation says, “come from.”] It shouldn’t be a responsibility ya Pastor che… [Congregation says, “chete,”] kuchengeta vana ava, ha’moona? Tofanira kuzvichengetera toga.

entries.title: The Revelation prt 14
entries.text: Ndosaka muchiona inini ndino—ndinorambidza vana Zipporah ava, kubuda. Izvozvi afonerwa namai vake. Ndikati, “Ah! Ah! Mai Zane endai naye. Mai vake vati vada kumuona pa Jameson. Moenda naye, moenda kumucheka. Haikona kumbomusiyai ipapo.’’ Ha’moona? Paakabva kuBu—hera akaona rima. “Iwe unoitei iwe?” Uyo Mercy uyo, aida kudzidza kuchii… ku—ku—ikoko. Ndikati, “Aah unongodzidza kana kuno.” Ha’moona nde’endichichengeta?

entries.title: The Revelation prt 14
entries.text: Nde’ndatoona kuti, “Hah, Mercy uyo ka uyo. Hah, nemarebero aya naMapuranga aya, aah? [Congregation laughs—ED] Zvogona kungoita hwava one time, handiti, eh? Tikaita muchato unonakidza chai…” [Congregation says, “chaizvo.”; Congregation laughs—ED] Ehe, tichiita sanduko dzekukambira. Amen. [Congregation laughs—ED] Ha’moona kuti Pastor is capable of doing anything? [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Don’t underestimate me, handitika? Handi’moona vanhu vaMwari?

entries.title: The Revelation prt 14
entries.text: Saka ndozvatenge tichitsvaga kuti vana… Unoona kuti musikana uyu akanaka. Iye zvino ndikatarisa vana brother eh… Takachengeta eh Bo—Boni naSimanga handitika? But oh, honai jaya raNyaude iri? [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Handi’munoona kuti VaNyaude ava? Was it wasted effort? [Congregation says, “no.”] You see, ha’moona? Iye zvino tiri kuchengeta Mercy uyu, manje manje anenge ari mudzimai wehama dziri panapa.

entries.title: The Revelation prt 14
entries.text: Monyatsoona mava…Nda’andichitarisa Mai Satiya, ndichiti, “Mai Satiya kuti ndifunge ndakaona …?... mwana wenyu anga ari pano chikomana. Kuti ndifunge kuti vana venyu?” Zvivana zvaSatiya zvakanaka. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Ndifunge Fay chaingova chisikana chebasa chemanga manga, but mukuona kuti vaane vana vavo? [Congregation says, “mm.”] Hah? A’amudzimai akazvidzikamira. Unenge uchinyatsoona kuti… Inini kwandiri zvinondipa pride because ndinyatsoona kuti aya… zvibereko zvangu izvi, [Congregation says, “Amen,”] ha’moona?

entries.title: The Revelation prt 14
entries.text: Ndikatarisa Keith na—na—na—na—na—naFadzi, Fadzi ndaingoona kari kasikana kemanga manga mumba maMai Kim, heh? Kanh—ka—ka—ka—kabenzi kanongotaurisa kanongoita makuhwa, kachi crosser crosser kuenda kwaMai Kim, kwa Mai Tito. [Congregation laughs—ED] Ndichiti, “Kamwana ka nuinsance aka handiti eh?” But iye zvino oh, ndiMai Deborah. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Handi’munoona kunaka kwenyasha handiti? [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Saka inini when I look at these girls, handiti? Ndiri kuona mhuri, [Congregation says, “Amen,”] mune ramangwa…? [Congregation says, “ramangwana.”] I never lose patience with them. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Ndoziva kuti, when Edgar comes to me, I’ll not run short of women to provide. [Congregation says, “Amen.”]

entries.title: The Revelation prt 14
entries.text: Ehe. Vapfanha vari kuMaenga vati—vanoda kuroora, I know where to go, for I have got a resource where they can marry, handi’moona? Even vakauya vebarika, we have somewhere where they can marry. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] But imi kana muchitarisa vasikana, maybe you don’t think that way, because of age, ha’moona? But they are very important to us, [Congregation says, “Amen,”] very important. PaChechi pano hapanakidze kana vasikana vasi… [Congregation says, “vasipo.”]

entries.title: The Revelation prt 14
entries.text: We must pray. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Ezvino ndikatarisa B—Doc—Doc Mupa, ndotoziva kuti vane nemuzukuru wangu Fay. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Handi’muri kuona kunaka kwenyasha? [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Ndotoziva kuti, “Hah nhai? Ka Fay kainge ka nuisance. Kakatinetsa zvakare kuka raiser kaya. Kakatitambudza muGweru umu, handitika?” But tarirai, ha’moona dzanyasha? [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Wakuti ukatarisa back ukaona Fay kudai, aah, akutondivigira drink kana achibva Botswana. Heh? Ndakutoti ndikaenda Botswana, ndogona kuti, “Aah, regai ndimbonorara kumba kwaMupa nhasi.” Tobikirwa zvakadii…? [Congregation says, “zvakanaka,] zvakanaka. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Heh?

entries.title: The Revelation prt 14
entries.text: We are building bonds that cannot be broken. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Iye zvino vapfanha vangu vese vari kuMaenga… Derek akamirira wake Sheilah. Jabu akamirira wake eh Edina, handitika? [Congregation says, “mm.”] Ehe! Murove akamirira wake Wedze. Vana vandakakudza pano turi tuvana twemanga manga, [Congregation says, “Amen,”] ehe. Sheilah akambotizaka futi uyu? Ma’matokanganwa? Moziva Sheilah akambotiza? [Congregation laughs—ED] Ari kwa’aBanda, makanganwa? Aah? Hama handizvizive? Tikamufungira kuti ndiye apaza tithes box, but tithes box ranga rapazwa namukoma Lay. [Congregation laughs—ED] But tarirai mukoma Lay iye zvino. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Amen! [Congregation says, “Amen.”]

entries.title: The Revelation prt 14
entries.text: Hama dzanga dzichi—dzama—hanzvadzi dzanga dzichivanyeya apapa. Zvikanzi, “But Brother Lay vanonakidza mazuva ano. Lay vachinja.” Zvikanzi, “Saka chikoro ari kuenda gore rinouya? But dai aitira muno, vachienda kuma college vachidzoka pano, because Lay has changed.” Lay waipaza tithes box ah, pa-a! Wotora envelope oenda onodii… onotenga ma sweets. Manje akapaza tithes box, zuva raapaza tithes box, Sheilah ndokudii…? [Congregation says, “ndokutiza,”] ndokutiza. [Congregation laughs—ED] Tikati watora tithes ndiyani…? [Congregation says, “ndi Sheilah.”] Takazomuwana hedu, Sheilah pamberi apo. Sheilah wakadzoka. Tiri ku hoper kuti Boni uchadiiwo…? [Congregation says, “uchadzoka,”] uchadzoka, handi’moona? Dai Sheilah tisina kumudzora, Derek angade ari chii…? [Congregation says, “ari hwava,”] hwava.

entries.title: The Revelation prt 14
entries.text: Mwari ngaatiitire ngoni manheru ano. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Handi’muri kupanzwaka varanda vaMwari? [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Ehe. Ngatipindei mukuteura kwakanyanya chaizvo. Hatidi kuti taita effort pamusikana … Ndosaka muchiona manje, ndinoita kutovabatirira kuti akakumbirira kana kuenda kumusha chaiko, nde’endichivarambidza, ha’moona? Iye zvino ndakatorambidza last week Tsitsi kuenda kuGweru. Aida kuita one week. Tsitsi has changed drastically ever since akagara naVaKakunga ava. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Mwana achinja iyeye, zvandisina kumbomuona akadii…? [Congregation says, “akaita,] akaita muhupenyu.

entries.title: The Revelation prt 14
entries.text: Nda’akumutyira manje. Iye zvino ndachiti, “Ukada kuenda ku Mkoba, you promise me you go one-night, mangwana uchidii…? [Congregation says, ‘uchidzoka,’] uchidzoka.” Handi’moona? Nde’ndichiziva kuti, “No, vana ava zvavarika…” Isusuka hatizvioni, tiri vanhu vokunamata. Pfungwa dzedu dzinenge dzakatarisa kuBhaibhiri nekuropafadzwa kwepanyama. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Mari. Zvekuti vasikana unenge uchiti, “No, ruchiva urwu. Handisi kuda kuisa pfungwa dzangu pazviri.”

entries.title: The Revelation prt 14
entries.text: But ininika ini, nde’ndichiziva kuti, “No, vapfanha vangu vachada pokuroora manje.” [Congregation says, “Amen.”] I’d be hurt to lose her now. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Saka ndomuziva, kuti vulnerability apo inenge yakati wa…? [Congregation says, “wandei.”] Saka paakati… Ndakati, “Ahh.” Ndakambomumisa. Ndikati, “No, kana kwasara one-week ye Combined Meeting ndokuendesa ne Monday wodzoka iri Friday.” Saka paakazodzoka Combined Meeting yapera. Zvikanzi, “Ndochienda?” Ndikati, “Aah, ozondiona Svondo inodii…?” [Congregation says, “inotevera.”] Nhasi ndikati, “No, wonoita one da…” Ndomuziva manje. Ukapota uchimuregera Tsitsi achibhururuka bhururuka, unongozoona imwe Svondo haa…? [Congregation says, “haamo,”] haamo. Ende takamuruza rungani Tsitsi? I don’t know how many times; I don’t know how many times we’ve lost that girl, ha’moona? Saka this time we don’t want to—that to happen a…? [Congregation says, “again, “] again! Handi’moona, ehe?

entries.title: The Revelation prt 14
entries.text: Saka ini nde’endichifunga like that. Ndomafungiro andinoita iwayo, ha’moona? Imi hamufunge sai…? [Congregation says, “saizvozvo.”] Because hamuzimi munovingwa zvichinzi, “Nda’akuda kuroora,” ha’moona? Leo anotozoda kuroora ipapapa, apedza kuimba Chizaruro chake chaa…?... [Congregation laughs—ED] Amen! Handiti? [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Saka ndinozoti kudii? Handitika ehe? Achadawo mhuri yaani…? [ Congregation says, “yake.”] Ehe. But it’s so beautiful when these guy—youngsters marry.

entries.title: The Revelation prt 14
entries.text: Ezvino nda’andichitarisa—ndichitarisa mudzimai wa Brother Musasa, ndichiti, “Sister Amanda, nduda kukuonai mune dumbu rinenge iro. Ehe.” Ndikati, “Kana mukaita dumbu rinenge iro, gore rinouya ndichanamata zvandisati ndakamboita.” Zvikanzi, “Haah,” nemasister, “Kuti munganamate?” Ndikati, “Muchaona. Nde’endichingoti ndikangopinda mu kitchen ndikamuona ane dumbu rakaita seiro, ndobva ndatoti, ‘Ngatinamatei,’ ipapo.” [Congregation laughs—ED] And I promise I will do that. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Pandinenge ndangosangana naye. Ndikangoburuka mumotokari ndikamuona chete akadai, ndino—ndobva ndatopfugama. Ndichanamata zvandisati ndakamboita. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Ndosaka Chishanu chino ndiri kukumbira kuti, “Mwari itai nyasha pana Amanda.” [Congregation says, “Amen.”]

entries.title: The Revelation prt 14
entries.text: Why was I saying that? Because that is another miracle. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Inyasha, isu tozvitora sezvinhu zvidii…? [Congregation says, “zvidiki.”] But inyasha dzaMwari idzo. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Hah? Vasarirwa ne two-three weeks kuenda ku delivery. [Congregation says, “mm.”] Tifunge nguva yatakaona mai ava vachimiskera, [as in miscarrying—ED] musikana uyu achimiskera, [to miscarry—ED] all the…? [Congregation says, “time,”] all the time, ha’moona? Unopa kutenda kuti, “Hah, isu Mwari vedu vanotida!” [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Vanotidaira muzvikumbiro zvedu zve…? [Congregation says, “zvese.”] Mm. Ndosaka iwewe neni munhu waMwari, Friday inoyi, haimbori Friday yekutamba. IFriday [it’s a Friday—ED] yekugugudza Mwari vazarure. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Kutsuura mweya yeurombo. Kutsuura mweya yekusanamata. Kutsuura mweya yemadzinza. Kutsuura huhedheni. Kutendeuka, kuita “…die what…?” [Congregation says, “daily, Amen.”]

entries.title: The Revelation prt 14
entries.text: Ndosaka mukaona musikana toita kutambura, kutsvaga. Mai Magunde vakambotizaka? [Congregation chuckles—ED] But va’amai ani nhasi…? [Congregation says, “Magunde.”] Mai—Mai Christabel. [Congregation laughs—ED] Handi’… Handi’makavaona vachitiimbira panapa? [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Hah? But takatambura. Vakatiwakisa sister ava vaenda Chinhoyi. Tadii… Tatenderera. Takatenderera kubva neuku ku texter kudii… Ndikashaudha Shiphra. Shiphra ndiye akaita get the brunt of that sister. Ndikati, “Iwewe ndiwe unonyatsoziva kuti chii cha’a chichiitika kune… Anga ari shamwari yako. Muwane. Zvino zvakanaka here zvawaita izvi?” Shiphra ndiye akatozomuwana manje, handi’moona?

entries.title: The Revelation prt 14
entries.text: Zvinoitika zvese zvatiri kutaura izvi. But kana pakaita vanhu vari vigilant, [Congregation says, “Amen,”] heh? You can avoid this situation. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Now, I give you the task in prayer, nekumutsvaga musikana uyu. Boni tomuda back pano! [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Ehe. Kana uri munhu ane motikari ukamuwana, mu kidnap-e. [Congregation laughs—ED; Congregation says, “Amen.”] Kana kune ma brother ari three, kana mukamuona haikona kumboita zvokutamba. Munongotarisa moona kuti hapana mapurisa here, modii… Motakura, mokanda mumotokari, movhara ma door, naye! Akauya kuno tinomusungirira todaidza VaMhlanga. Te’etakamurovera chipikiri pa yard apa. Ende toisa chain chaidzo kuti, “Iwewe ukuda kuenda kupi?”

entries.title: The Revelation prt 14
entries.text: Remember mwana uyu akazvarwa pasi peshumiro ino. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Hah? Akaberekwa pasi pe ministry yangu, [Congregation says, “Amen,”] ha’moona, ehe? Ende baba vake vanona…? [Congregation says, “vanonamata.”] Ndo vakavadzora. Izvi zvaaita izvi havazvidii izvi. [Congregation says, “havazvizive.”] Havazvizive, ende havazvidi. I’ve been trying to get a hold of him for a long time. Phone yavo ichiramba kuita through, kuti ndivaudze ndozvaita mwa…? [Congregation says, “mwana,”] mwana. Vanoenda out nebasa. He di… he was here a few weeks ago. Hm? Vauya kuzoona vana vavo, ha’moona? Saka mofunga kuti vanozvida izvi?

entries.title: The Revelation prt 14
entries.text: Now, that man trusted us with his daughter. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] It will be very difficult kuti timutaurire kuti mwana uya hatizivi kwaakadii…? [Congregation says, “kwaakaenda.”] Ndosaka mukamuona, ukamuona kana mune motokari, handitika? You hear my instruction? [Congregation says, “Amen.”] You what…? [Congregation says, “kidnap her.”; Congregation laughs—ED] Munongotora mokanda mumota mouya naye! Achisvika pano ndongomuvharira, ndoti, “Hauna kwauri kuenda.” Phone tinomudi…? Imi chokutanga mukangomukanda mobva mamutorera fo…? [Congregation says, “foni.”] No communica…? [Congregation says, “communication.”] Mouya naye.

entries.title: The Revelation prt 14
entries.text: Hatide kuita sevanhu vakapusa vanhu vaMwari. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Nhai mungaregere bhebhi richienda makatarisa kumuhedheni? [Congregation chuckles—ED] Muchingoti, “Sister dzokai.” Uyu haapupurirwe uyu. Anozviziva zvese zvekunamata. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] You don’t testify to her, ha’moona? Munongotakura chete, ha’moona? Kuri kuti kana une simba rakanyanya-nyanya ingoisa pai…? [Congregation says, “pamafudzi.”; Congregation laughs—ED] Unongosunga mawoko nemakumbo okanda apa. Naye handitika? [Apostle Gumbura laughs—ED] Nokuti i—mwana wedu chaiye chaiye. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] That’s what I would give her. Esther nhasi akatiza uyu, I would tell everybody kuti, “Wese amuwana, mudhonze uwuye nani…?” [Congregation says, “naye.”]

entries.title: The Revelation prt 14
entries.text: That’s what I would tell everybody. Kuti, “Ini handisikuda… Ndoda kuti mumu… Mangwana vanhu vaMwari, we are going to spread and comb every area. Anenge amubata, ingokakata chete uchiuya nani…?” [Congregation says, “naye.”] Vana vangu ava. …?... woenda kupi? Ha’moona? But izvi, honai zvataitwa apa, handi’moona? Ndosaka mumwe nemumwe wedu, we have a duty to pray for that girl. [Apostle knocks several times on pulpit—ED; Congregation says, “Amen.”] And we have a duty to pray for every girl ari pa…? [Congregation says, “ari pano,”] ari pano. Ndosaka muchiona ndichi complainer kuti, “Aiwa hatidi vana vedu kuti vaparare.” Unenge watambura naye, achikura mwana iyeye. [Congregation says, “Amen.”]

entries.title: The Revelation prt 14
entries.text: Ukafunga matamburiro atakaita nana Thembi, nana Busie nana Zoe ava, nhasi va’ane ma degree, kwakuvapa kuna professor, just like that? Is that sanity? Imimi hazvikurwadzei because unenge usina kumbobvisa mari paa…? [Congregation says, “paari.”] Iwe unenge wakati hembe, sadza, accommodation, transportation, tuition fees; then mangwana omuka achinzi haa…? [Congregation says, “haapo.”] What a poor investment, ha’moona? Izvozvo izvo ndozviziva vanhu vaMwari. Imimi munogona kusaona saizvozvo. Ndosaka tese tine responsibility.

entries.title: The Revelation prt 14
entries.text: Kana imi ma sisters mamwe imimi, mune duty rekutaura nemwana uyu. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Mukamuona kuti, “Ha—ru—hazvina mhosva kuti wakanga watsamwa nechii, kana wakanga waite nechii? Zvekubva paChechi zviri wrong. Either way you want to think abou…?” [Congregation says, “about it.”] Hm? Tikatanga kufunga tichiti kana musi wandinokanganisa inini even sa Pastor, munhu anoita justification yekubva paChechi, pane angazotore mwana akamuendesa kuchikoro? You see? Tikatanga kufunga mafungiro iwayo? Who would gamble? Ndiyani angazochengeta mumwe munhu pano nhasi? Iwe haukanganise? Saka why did…? This is faith. Handitomboziva kuti Miriam achaita sei Svondo inouya?

entries.title: The Revelation prt 14
entries.text: Handitomboziva kuti, eh, Hazvi acha behavior sei gore rinouya? But nevertheless, I put my trust in Hazvi. Tikamupa course yatisingagone kumuto…? [Congregation says, “kumutorera.”] Tikamupa accommodation, chikafu, chatisingagone kumutorera because that is faith mumunhu, trust mumunhu heh? Iye wozoti musi waanofunga kuti ndakanganisirwa kachinhu one, obva atora trust yose iyoyo ora…? [Congregation says, “orasa.”] Haaah, it’s not fair. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Ha’moona? That’s not fair. That’s very unfa…? [Congregation says, “unfair.”] Ha’moona ehe? Nekuti isu takaisa trust mauri tisinga… Hatina kumbofunga kuti ungatichinjire sai…? [Congregation says, “saizvozvo.”] Hm?

entries.title: The Revelation prt 14
entries.text: We thought you are going to be brothers. We thought we are brothers and si…? [Congregation says, “sisters.”] Till death do we what…? [Congregation says, “part.”] That’s what we thought! Takafunga kuti tiri kuenda kudenga to…? [Congregation says, “tose.”] Ndosaka Runya anodzoka pano. Achigara pano. Achienda kuchikoro. Anotsvagirwa na—na Sister Nehohwa, kumu kriyetera, [to create—ED] situation kusvika a-graduater. [to graduate—ED] Ndosaka makaona pakanga padzokera Kudzai takagomera, but Mwari vakamira ku actor here Mwari? [Congregation says, “mm-mm.”] Achingodzokera kumashure, mapurisa anga ati soo naye. Nokuti Mwari vanenge vachiona zvawakaitirwa nekutenda nevamwe. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Ha’moona?

entries.title: The Revelation prt 14
entries.text: Iye zvino right now, God will look what I— what the Church will have done for you, and whatever the Church has done for you, it’s God who has done that for you. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Saka you must return that back, nekunamata kwakana…? [Congregation says, “kwakanaka,”] nekuzochengetawo va…? [Congregation says, “vamwe, Amen.”] Eternal loyalty, [Congregation says, “Amen,”] ha’moona? Zvino ngatiregerei kukanganisa even vatsva vanouya. Vatsva vanouya vanenge vane chii…? vanobatsirika chaizvo.

entries.title: The Revelation prt 14
entries.text: Tina Sister Mangwiro ava. Ndaivati, “Aah, mofanira kuuya kuzopa testimony yenyu.” Vakarota hope, imagine. Varota muhope imomomo, vakarota eh, ini ndichitaura navo. Listen, munyuwani sister ava, handitika? Muhope imomo ndaivati, “Sister Mangwiro, vanhu vakawanda ndinovayambutsa. Ndayambutsa vanhu vakawanda chaizvo. Asi zvinoitika ndezvekuti vanhu vese vandinoyambutsa ava, vanozondi betrayer.” Is that a lie? [Congregation says, “no.”] Moona sister vakaroteswa naMwari ava. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Ndikati, “Sister, hope iyoyo pamarota iyoyoyo, ndiye Mwari.” Zvikanzi, “Mabva matora chimwe chinhu mugore. Muguti. Matora chinhu chiya chiya ichi, ndobva mandipa.”

entries.title: The Revelation prt 14
entries.text: Panguva iyoyo handi’muri kuzviona? Sister Chipo Chipato vari kuvati ndipeyi ndikugadzirirei CV yenyu. Vavagadzirira CV yavo, ndoka… Hanzi muhope imomo ndikavaudza kuti, “Dzokerai kwamakamboenda ma application.” One kwacho kwavakanga kwayenda ma applications. Zvikanzi, “Chiuyai utange basa nezuro.” [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Ha’moona kuti inyasha dzaMwari? [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Munhu anenge achangotendeuka faith yake yakaza…? [Congregation says, “yakazara, Amen.”] Mwari obva aita nya…? [Congregation says, “nyasha.”]

entries.title: The Revelation prt 14
entries.text: But nokupera kwenguva unoona kutenda kuya kuya kuchipera mumunhu. Ndozviri kukonzera hurombo hwatinahwo panapa. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Maonero ehama, vafundisi, ari ron’o, [as in wrong—ED; Congregation says, “Amen,”] ha’moona? Ukange une kutenda… Handi’ndakakutaurirai kuti, pese paunorota Mwari achitaura newe, unorota ini ipapo. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Ndini ndinotouya ipa…? [Congregation says, “ipapo.”] Mwari Ari kutaura kuti representation yangu, body yandiri kushandisa kutaura newe kwauri iwewe… [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Izvozvi Ari kutaura nemi manheru ano ndiani…? [Congregation says, “ndiMwari.”] Ndini homwe yacho. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Saka pese paanenge achida kukuratidza kuti ndauya kwauri muhope, unoona ani… unoona inini. [Congregation says, “Amen.”]

entries.title: The Revelation prt 14
entries.text: Ndosaka mumwe nemumwe wedu vanhu vaMwari handiti? Hatibatei chizaruro ichochichi! [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Toda chizaruro ichochi. Ndosaka muteuro we Friday uyu hau… ha—handi—ndiri kutogomera kuti December yasara just three months away, nokuti nda’andisingadi kuipedza, muteuro. Taka’a tati gore ka? But ini nda’andichiti, “Hah, muteuro uyuka uyu, unonakidza muteuro uyu. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Iropafadzo chai…? [Congregation says, ‘chairo.’] Handidi kuti upere muteuro iwowu.” Toda kupinda mugore rinouya futi nani…? [Apostle and Congregation say, “nawo!”] Chishanu chega chega tichinyengetera, [Congregation says, “Amen,”] kutsuura mweya yei…? [Congregation says, “yetsvina, Amen.”]

entries.title: The Revelation prt 14
entries.text: Ende mukatarisa kuti muone kuti pano pane nyasha. Mukaona mauyiro akauya akaita Sister Mangwiro ava, hatisi kutaura zvakawanda. Ganda che…? [Congregation says, “chete.”] Mwari havana kuita nyasha here apa? [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Sister vakauya vakasakara ivava, kusakara, kusakara face yachona …?... vaine complex vasinga… Hah?! Handina kumboziva kuti mudzimai akanaka soo, after nyasha dzadii…? [Congregation says, “dzawanda.”] Zvokuti ndakatozoona kuti hama iyi ine mwana atiza iyi yandaiti ihama iyi ikange yadzoka iyi Mwari aite nyasha, hah vakavaona ava havamiri zvavo… Ha’moona kuti inyasha dzaMwari chaidzo idzi? [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Heh? Ihanzvadzi yakanaka fani iyi. Munhu anofanawo kuvawo zvake nemurume wake ozvigarira, ozvinamatira akamira kuuya kwani…? [Congregation says, “kwaShe,”] kwaShe. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Hm? Perfect, ha’moona?

entries.title: The Revelation prt 14
entries.text: Oona kuti Satani anodzimaidza Mwari zvaanenge achida kuita. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] God’s plans for us are very beau…? [Congregation says, “beautiful, Amen.”] Unobuda kana uri munyasha, [Congregation says, “Amen,”] Amen. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Ehe. Ndosaka mumwe nemumwe wedu manheru ano, toda kupinda mumuteuro. Tongogoverana kwekanguva kadiki diki Message yedu handitika? [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Message yedu ye…Kuti origin yemweya iyi, ye… iri two mu Church iyi handitika? Message yedu inonzi The Reve… [Congregation says, “Revelation.”] Origin yemweya iyi two iri mu Church iyi, handi’ tinoiziva mweya miviri iri mu Church? Framework ye Church ine mweya mungani? [Congregation says, “muviri.”] Muviri handitika? Ehe. Origin yemweya iyoyo iyo, ende chinoikonzera mweya yacho iyo…? Matthew chapter 7. Handei kuna Matthew chapter… Amen. Tatoparidza hedu kare handitika? Kungoti tiwane ruGwaro.

entries.title: The Revelation prt 14
entries.text: Tiri pano mangwana nenyasha dzaMwari. Hameno kuti kana Brother Gwendere vazo succeeder? Ta succeeder? Tinoita ma days mangani? Sa—Saturday? Hah, horaiti. Saka mangwana Saturday pa Hallingbury apa, handitika? Saka what we are going to do tomorrow, it’s between two and five? Twelve-thirty? [A brother says, “twelve and six.”] Twelve and six? Toita between twelve and six mangwana. Tinozotaura whether tichazoita ne Sunday because Sunday kana tikaita tinoitira futi mu… munomu. But togara ku back uku handitika? Hah, panze panondiuraya. Handi’moona chika—chikosoro chiya hachisati chapera? [Congregation says, “mm.”] Imhepo. Unless tikazokwanisa kugadzira a podium inenge iri a bit prote…? [Congregation says, “protected,”] protected.

entries.title: The Revelation prt 14
entries.text: Ndakaita chikosoro after that week iya chiri kuramba kupera nanhasi pa chest. Handi’monzwa kuti voice rangu it’s not normal? [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Kuparidza panze kuya, kunouraya, mhepo. Handei kuna Matthew chapter 7 [Apostle clears throat—ED] Message iyi takaiisa kuma DVDs handitika? [Congregation says, “Amen”] Ehe. But tichangotangira pamberi mbijana. Handi’takaiona tese ka iyi? Ta’akuziva, Matthew chapter 7, I went over that one. Ha’moona? Kusvika takanga ta’a pana verse 15. Ndopataka’a tasvika nezuro, handitika? [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Tasvikaka? [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Pa verse 15 panotiyo, hativerengei tose: Beware of false prophets, which come to you in sheep’s clothing, but inwardly they are ravening wolves.

entries.title: The Revelation prt 14
entries.text: Amen. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Ndopatakati munhu ngaanamate kuti abate chizaruro chemufudzi! [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Mufudzi hauvhotere. [voting—ED] Ndiudze kuti unoziva sei munhu anouya akaita segwayi. Akapfeka segwayi. Asi mukati make ririii…? Wolf igava! Handi’mapaona? [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Unouya sei? Kune munhu akadaro uchinomu identifier kuti ndofunga mukati make i wolf, asi kunze ichionekwa sehwa…? [Congregation says, “sehwai.”] Zva’angofanana neni pano, how do you know whether I’m a wolf or I’m a sheep? Bhaibhiri rinongoti, “Be…? [Congregation says, ‘beware,’] beware of false pro…?” [Congregation says, “prophets.”] How are you going to know them?

entries.title: The Revelation prt 14
entries.text: Vazhinji venyu vanofunga kuti ukamuona, anenge aine muswe, aine nyanga, aah aah! Kana kuti haagoni kutaura maGwaro. Kana kuti haagoni kuverenga ma Scriptures. Zvese izvozvo anogona. Hapana chaanenge asingago…? [Congregation says, “asingagoni.”] Maybe kuparidza anotokunda vanhu vanenge vari genuine kuparidza chaiko. Pane zvinoonekwa anenge ari munhu waMwari chai…? [Congregation says, “chaiye.”] Zvino how are you going to know, ha’moona? Mwari havasiye chinhu chiri incomplete. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Hatiitei Amen ipapo hama! [Congregation says, “Amen.”]

entries.title: The Revelation prt 14
entries.text: Ndosaka munhu wese… hama dzaimba chizaruro idzi. Namata kuti, “Mwari ndokumbirawo chizaruro chemufudzi. [Congregation says, ‘Amen.’] Ndokumbirawo revelation ya Pastor. [Congregation says, ‘Amen.’] Ndokumbirawo Mweya waMwari kuti undijekesere kuti mutungamiriri wangu ndia…?” [Congregation says, “ndiani, Amen.”] Nhasi zuva rekutsanya tanga ipapo. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Tingaita Amen here ipapo hama? [Congregation says, “Amen.”]

entries.title: The Revelation prt 14
entries.text: Now you must always bear in mind, kuti pastor hazvirevi kuti havakanganise. Aiwa munhu zve. Satani anongomuedza sezvaanoitawo i…? [Congregation says, “iwe.”] But chinokuita kuti urambe una pastor ivavo umire navo, chizaruro chokuziva kuti ndivo pastor vaani…? [Congregation says, “vangu.”] It’s like a relationship between father and son. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Or daughter and fa…? [Congregation says, “father.”] Baba vako ndibaba vako regardless.

entries.title: The Revelation prt 14
entries.text: Nyangwe ukanzwa kuti baba vako kana kuti mai vako vanoroya, unoita sei? Munoti tsumo yekuti, “Muroyi royera kure,” handiti, yakaitirwei iyoyo? Kana mai vangu vachiroya ini handizvizivi, nokuti ini ndoziva kuti vakandibikira sa…? [Congregation says, “sadza.”] Ndosaka ndiripo nha…? [Congregation says, “nhasi.”] Ndakayamwa mukaka waani…? [Congregation says, “wavo.”] Zvekuti vanoroya izvo handizvizive. Muroyi kune vamwe but kwandiri hava…? [Congregation says, “havazi.”] Ndosaka hakuna mwana anoramba mai, nyangwe zvikaita sei ha’moona? Ha—unongorangarira zvakanaka zvavakakuitira. [Congregation says, “Amen.”]

entries.title: The Revelation prt 14
entries.text: Ivo vana mai vanofunga tinokanganwa, but we don’t. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Ndai’chitotaura namainini vangu nhasi, vachinditenda ndavatengera mucheka we—wekuti vaitirwe skirt iyi, munin’ina wamai vangu. Zvikanzi, “Hah, maita Matere.” [Apostle claps hands twice—ED] Ndikati, “Aiwa amai ndokuzvara, makandirera matokanganwa.” Zvikanzi, “Handina kumboka…” Ndikati, “Aah, ko ku St Michaels?” Zvikanzi, “Ehe.”

entries.title: The Revelation prt 14
entries.text: Vakauya tiri ku…Highfiridzi, amai—amainini vangu ava. Baba vasingasevenzi vachirwa—vachirwara ne fits. Mu’kuona zvoita hupenyu? [Congregation says, “mmm.”] Ivo vanga vaine murume wavo kuGweru, vachiita mari chaizvo vari… Babamunini vanga vaine degree. Vainzi Gibson Mwanza. Babamunini vedu. Zvikanzi, “Vana havangaregi kuenda kuchikoro.” Ndobva vatitora inini na Innocent tiri two. Ndokuenda kunotidzidzisa eh, ku St Michaels, kunotitsvagira nzvimbo. I was there for about two to three years, pachikoro chatakatsvagirwa namainini vangu. Vari ivo varikutenga sadza, vachibhadhara school fees. Baba vangu vanga vasikwa…? [Congregation says, “kwanisi.”] Iye zvino ndakuvaona vakura manje vadai. Can you forget that? [Congregation says, “no.”]

entries.title: The Revelation prt 14
entries.text: Ha’moona zvinoita hupenyu? [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Saka nyangwe ukaona munhu achivabata rough, haumbofe wakakanganwa kuti, “Aiwazve, vaita sei?” Ndosaka munhu anogona kuti, “Usachengete, vasiye!” Iwe unenge uchiziva kuti, “Aah ah. Inini vakambondidii…?” [Congregation says, “vakandichengeta, Amen.”] Handi—hazvina mhosva. “He-e mainini vako vanga vachiti…” Vakakuti, “Zvakati zvakati.” Vakakuti, “Zvakati zvakati.” …?... “But heyi, there was a time when that same mainini, looked a…” [Congregation says, “after me.”]

entries.title: The Revelation prt 14
entries.text: Moziva kuchengeta munhu one year kwakaoma fani. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] From January to December, uchimutengera hembe, pekugara nechekudya. Pasina rudo hauzvidii…? [Congregation says, “hauzvikwanisi, Amen.”] But she did it, ha’moona? Saka haugone kuzvikanganwa nhasi. Ndo the same zvaunofanira kufunga iwewe, [Congregation says, “Amen,”] kuti, “Pastor vangu vakandifudza kwemakore!” [Congregation says, “Amen.”]

entries.title: The Revelation prt 14
entries.text: Uya mweya wevanhu vaya vanoti, “He-e pastor handidi kuvaona. He-e pastor vakashata. Pastor vakadai vakadai. Pastor…” Uya unonzi huSatani huya. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Mweya yetsvi…? [Congregation says, “yetsvina.”] Vakafanana nevana vanorova vabereki. Vana vanoti kana vabudirira, havadi kuti vabereki vavashanyire kana kumabasa avo chai…? [Congregation says, “chaiko.”] Ukarangarira kuti at one time that person stood for you, hakuna musikana kana mukomana anobva pano akagumbuka, kunyangwe wamukanganisira sei! [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Nokuti anorangarira zvakanaka zvawakambomudii…? [Congregation says, “zvawakamuitira, Amen.”]

entries.title: The Revelation prt 14
entries.text: Ndosaka imimi mese, hapana asina kuregerera mubereki wake. Vamwe vabereki venyu vakaita zviri worse, vakaramba vana mai venyu.
