Vamwe vana mai venyu vakaramba vana baba venyu, vakatobatwa vaine zvikomba. But you don’t want to see them now? Why is it that kana ma’amu Church, you take such hard lines. You become holier than thou…? [Congregation says, “thou art, Amen.”] Muri kupaona vanhu vaMwari? Ndopandiri kukutaurirai kuti munhu akadaro ano lacker Chiza…? [Congregation says, “Chizaruro, Amen.”]

entries.title: The Revelation prt 14
entries.text: Munhu anonamata anoti, “Mwari ndizarurireiwo! [Congregation says, ‘Amen.’] Ndoda kuziva munhu wamakatuma panyika pano kuti anditungamiri…?” [Congregation says, “mirire, Amen.”] Tingaita Amen here ipapo hama? [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Toda Amen akadarika ipapo. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Ini ndakazviona ini zvichiitika nokuti ndakachatisa… pandakachatisa vana Sister Mukwenya. Aah! VaMukwenya vanga vasingadi kuona mai va Sister Mukwenya. Vanga vaine vamwe vakadzi vavo two, vavanga vainavo. Kuramba kugara padhuze naMai Mukwenya. Ini ndikati, “Aiwazve, motogara pabenji rimwe chete nekuti ndimi mune vana muri two, kwete ava.”

entries.title: The Revelation prt 14
entries.text: Takazviona kasingadii…? Kasingaperi, ha’moona? Vanhu vanenge vasingaonani. But kuti utaurire mwana uyu kuti, “Ida mai chete.” Kana kuti, “Ida baba chete.” Zvinoita izvozvo? Vabereki vake ve…? [Congregation says, “vese, Amen.”]

entries.title: The Revelation prt 14
entries.text: Now, kana tichiona zvinhu zvichiitika in the natural, zvinhu zviri so complicated, ziva kuti Satani is a complicator of issues, [Congregation says, “Amen,”] nguva dzo…? [Congregation says, “dzose.”] Anoku kriyetera complicated situation paChechi. But haikona kuhedhuka nayo. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Ndopanonzi neBhabhiri, “…Kana munhu aine chizaruro, masuwo egahena!” [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Hatite Amen varanda vaMwari! [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Hatite Amen akadarika ipapo. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Hanzi, “…Masuwo egahena shall not pre…?” [Congregation says, “prevail.”] Ha’moona?

entries.title: The Revelation prt 14
entries.text: Brother vanenge vachinamata Mwari chaivo chaivo, hazvina basa kuti chii chaitika mukati mekunamata kwako? [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Haurasikirwe nechite…? [Congregation says, “nechitendero.”] Haurasikirwe nechiza…? [Congregation says, “nechizaruro.”] Whether it involves women. Whether it involves men. Whether it involves money. Whether it involves food. Whether… whatever it is!!! Whether it involves accommodation, “…the gates of…? [Apostle and Congregation say, ‘hell,’] should not pre…” [Congregation says, “prevail, Amen.”] Tingaita Amen here ipapo hama? [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Handisi kumunzwa Amen iyeye? [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Toda Amen akadarika ipapo. [Congregation says, “Amen.”]

entries.title: The Revelation prt 14
entries.text: Ndosaka munhu wese ari muno ngaanamate kuti, “Mwari, ndoda kuziva pastor vangu.” [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Nekuti Mwari havakupi ma pastor mangani…? [Apostle and Congregation say, “maviri.”; Congregation says, “Amen.”] You will have one pastor, [Congregation says, “Amen,”] “…who is ordained to see you what…?” [Congregation says, “through.”] Saka the devil can come and throw the spanner in the works, woita blinded. Now, the moment you are blinded, you will look for a pastor. But that person that you choose as a pastor, neziso rako, is not a pastor to you. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Tingaita Amen here varanda vaMwari? [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Toda Amen akadarika ipapo. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Toda Amen akapfuura ipapo. [Congregation says, “Amen.”]

entries.title: The Revelation prt 14
entries.text: Ndosaka tine ma brother akabuda kuenda kuma pastors. Zvikanofamba vaenda kuma pastor? Muri kuona zvakaitika? Vakatsvaga ma pastor aani…? [Congregation says, “avo.”] Vana Bernard vakatsvaga chii…? [Congregation says, “ma pastor.”] Zviri kufamba? Vana Omega vakatsvaga ma pastor, zviri kufamba?

entries.title: The Revelation prt 14
entries.text: Handichazivi aitonditaurira kuti, “Haaah, mukoma Omega zvazooma.” Oh ndi—vekwa—vekwaZimhuka. Ndo… NdekwaZimhukaka? Ku—ku—kuna vana tezvara vana—vana Pastor Rusono? [Brother says, “Amen.”] Handitika? [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Ehe. Hanzi, “Ndaitaura navo vamwe vacho vanonamata vachiti, ‘Ko, uyu Omega madii mamubatsira veduwe.’” Zvikanzi, “Zvinhu zvacho zvakamu-presser hazvisi kudii…? [Brothers says, “hazvisi kufamba.”] Iye zvino mukadzi ari kunzi akatyoka gumbo. Ende vana vari kunetsa kudii… Inongori one miscarriage after ano…?” [Congregation says, “another.”]

entries.title: The Revelation prt 14
entries.text: Mukuona kuti i curse iyi? [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Uku ari kusasavara kuti, “Ndakadanwa.” Mukuona zvaanange achiita? Ari kusasavara kuti “Ndakadanwa.” Heh? Akadanwa here mukomana uya? [Congregation says, “aiwa/ah-ah.”] Moona zvinoita Mwari ka? [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Dai mupfanha uya ari pano, nhamo dzese dzaari kuona idzodzo angade asina. [Congregation says, “Amen.”]

entries.title: The Revelation prt 14
entries.text: Muri kuona pattern yehupenyu huri kurarama Omega? [Congregation says, “mm.”] Munhu akabuda mu will yaani…? [Congregation says, “yaMwari.”] Tingaita Amen here ipapo hama? [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Toda Amen akadarika ipapo? [Congregation says, “Amen.”]

entries.title: The Revelation prt 14
entries.text: Ndaka’a ndichiona muzukuru wangu achiuya panapa, Crosby, nemudzimai wake Flo. Vachiuya panapa vari kubva kwaChitsinde uko, handiti? Unonyatsoona vanhu vari out of the will of what…? [Congregation says, “of God.”] Havana chavakura pamweya. Haana chaanoziva pamweya, kunze kwenha…? [Congregation says, “kwenharo.”] Hapana. Hanzi, “Sekuru musanditemewo kani mazuva ano.” Ndikati, “Handimboregi! Nekuti iwe unokuti kutema, asi ini ndinokuti kudzidzi…?” [Congregation says, “kudzidzisa.”] Hm?

entries.title: The Revelation prt 14
entries.text: Handimboziva kudanwa kwemunhu anodanwa out of controversy. Unobva paChechi pauri kushaudhana nevanhu, woenda wonoita ministry. Ende ministry yacho ino flourisher under a pastor, ari kuda kuparadza ku Church kwawakadii…? [Congregation says, “kwawakabva.”] Is that a ministry? [Congregation says, “no.”]

entries.title: The Revelation prt 14
entries.text: I’ve never seen a ministry like that in my whole wildlife! Heh? Unoenda kune mufundisi ane—anovenga Pastor vawakabva kwawu… Ari kuda ku prover a point kuna pastor ivavo. Hah? Hanzi, ari kukususumidza. Ende chinondinakidza, hechi. Ko, ivo pastor ivava havana here vanhu vavowo here ikoko vavakakudzawo? Vanotora vapfanha vanobva kune Chechi dzomumwe murume, wavanoti ndiSatani murume iye…? [Congregation says, “iyeye.”] Asi otora vana vake vaakaparidzira, ovaita vafundisi muchechi maani…? [Congregation says, “make,”] mako.

entries.title: The Revelation prt 14
entries.text: Vanoparidzirwa na Crosby. Imagine kuti i ministry idzodzo? Vapedza kuparidzirwa na Crosby, vanoparidzirwa na Innocent Nehohwa. Vapedza kuparidzirwa na Innocent, izvezviso Omega akauya nemukadzi wake akatyoka gumbo, vanomupa service ne Sunday. [Congregation laughs—ED] “Beware of false prophets…!” [Apostle knocks pulpit twice—ED; Congregation says, “Amen.”] Toda Amen akadarika Amen! [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Toda Amen akadarika ipapo! [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Unoona zvipfanha zvedu zvakabva patiri because… Iye makwai akadaro haa…? [Congregation says, “haana.”] Haakwanise kudzidzisa vanhu kusvika pa level i…? [Congregation says, “iyoyo.”]

entries.title: The Revelation prt 14
entries.text: Unoona zvichimupukuta eh, marara kudai, zvichimupukuta marara eh, parufu kudai. Mupfanha akamira zvake …?... maihwe. Handidi kumbokunyeperai, maitiro anoita hama dzedu dzimwe dzemu Message, ndeesha…? [Apostle and Congregation say, “shaisano.”] Ndeekuda kuparadza kwakabva vanhu. Pfungwa yaivepo ndeyekuti vapfanha vakaonekwa vachisimudzwa …?... zvichaita kuti tikwezve vanhu variko, vaine pfungwa dzekuti tinouya todai. Kute… Kurarama kwedu kwatiri kuita panapa, tiri kurarama nekuti Mwari vanoda kuti tivepo! [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Ngatiite Amen akadarika Amen hama. [Congregation says, “Amen.”]

entries.title: The Revelation prt 14
entries.text: But varume vakaedza kutiparadza variko. Kutitadzirira kwavakadii uku…? [Congregation says, “kwavakaita.”] Ende ndoda kuti ndikutaurirei chokwadi, takatovakunda vanhu ivavo. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Hadzisi nhema. Takavaita sei vanhu ava…? [Congregation says, “takavakunda.”] Vaifunga kuti vana Innocent vakanzi va’a vaparidzi, vana Bernard vakanzi va’a vaparidzi, vana Omega va’a vaparidzi, mese muchamhanya, kidi kidi, kunoitwa vaparidzi. Vaifunga kuti zvinobata, heh?

entries.title: The Revelation prt 14
entries.text: But vapfanha vacho yava headache manje kwavari ikoko. Matangiro ezvinhu akaita seaya aya anoti netseyi. Havambofa vakavagona vapfanha ivo vaya. Pachauya imwe cli—chao—creation ichaita kuti iye atange kutaura kuti, “Vanhu ivava takavatora kwakati.” Nekuti zvinenge zvamusha…? [Congregation says, “zvamushatira.”] Origin yechinhu… But isu tinobva tabata kuti; “Aah ah, aah ah, aah ah, mukuru uyoyoyo, une chinangwa chisina Mweya waMwari muka…?” [Congregation says, “mukati, Amen.”] Zvino ini ndo’zvandakanakira vanhu vaMwari. Handimbofa ndakatora munhu anobva kune any church, ndichimuita pastor pano ini. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] I’m not mad. Ndosaka vana Brother Chatima nana Brother Innocent vakauya vakagara panapa. Most of you thought nekuti mupfanha wangu, ndichangoyerekana ndamupa pulpit mangwa…? [Congregation says, “mangwana.”] Ndakamupa? Haana kudzimara vakatiza vachi comprainer nyaya iyoyo? Handitambe nepurupiti [pulpit—ED] zve type iyo…? [Congregation says, “iyoyo, Amen.”] Moreso now, after October 2…? [Congregation says, “2000.”]

entries.title: The Revelation prt 14
entries.text: Mweya wekungosimudza chero munhu wawaunza panapa, uno regretter rimwe gore, a’akuzvivakira hushe hwaani…? [Congregation says, “hwake.”] Dzidziso akuunza yani…? [Congregation says, “yake.”] Ende ari muzodziwa wenhe…? [Congregation says, “wenhema.”] “Beware of false prophets.” [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Hatinyengeterei takatarisana nenyaya iyoyo Chishanu chanhasi. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] “Mwari ndoda kuziva kuti mutumwa ndiani?” [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Amen. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Mwari vakatiratidza kuti tinoziva sei kuti vatumwa ndivanani. Hatitarisei ...?... Verse… hativerengei tose: Ye shall know them by their fruits. Do men gather grapes of thorns, or figs of thistles?

entries.title: The Revelation prt 14
entries.text: Muri kupaona? [Congregation says, “Amen.”] “Muchavaziva nezvibereko zvaani…?” [Congregation says, “zvavo.”] Ndoda Amen akadarika Amen ipapo. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Ndoda Amen akadarika ipapo. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Handisikumunzwa Amen iyeye! [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Haapfure ipapo Amen iyeye! [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Ndoda kuti ndikuudzei kuti, nhasi VaChitsinde vanoparidza vachiti, “Brother Gumbura is a fa—false anointed.” Handitika? But vanoti Kiro, [Crosby—ED] Innocent, Omega vaparidzi handitika? Vagoti, Mudekwa, Musharu vana Mai Mlambo handitika? Vamwe vacho ndatovakanganwa, vanopinda i…? [Congregation says, “ikoko.”] Vavakatora kupi? [Congregation says, “pano.”] Hatichinzwai kuti according to Scripture, zvinobvumirana here zvavari kutaura nezvinodzidzisa Mwa…? [Congregation says, “Mwari.”] Hativerengei tione. Verse 7, 17 tese: Even so every good tree bringeth forth good fruit; but a corrupt tree bringeth forth evil fruit.

entries.title: The Revelation prt 14
entries.text: Ndoda Amen akadarika Amen. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Ndoda Amen akadarika Amen ipapo. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Toda Amen akadarika ipapo! [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Nhasi uno kana VaManyere chaivo ku Botswana vakawana VaMandiya, ndiye anenge atovawo munhu wavowo iyeye. Makambozviona izvozvo? Murandu nhasi akawana izvo, a—akawana Manyuchi, akawana Marima, akawana Ma—Marisa, atowanawo makwa…? [Congregation says, “makwayi.”] Vachibva pamuti wakadii…? [Congregation says, “waka...”] Tongai ndimi.

entries.title: The Revelation prt 14
entries.text: Ko sei ndiine raki rekuti panobva vanhu vakanaka pandiri? Heh? Why? Hazvina mhosva kuti ndiani. Even ari musikana. Ivo vana sister vatiri kutaura vari kutiza panapa, vakanopinda kuchechi kwanaChitsinde munovanzwa kunzi vatova number one ikoko. Vana Madovi, vakashanyirwa kudzimba vachisvika kuchechi idzo dziye. Kuzoonekwa kunzi, “Hah, muri vafu—muri vanhu chaivo chaivo.” Vachi parker motokari dzekuma company kudai. “But mufundisi wenyu, mufundisi wenyu.”

entries.title: The Revelation prt 14
entries.text: Manje Madovi ndakamuwana ari muhedheni. Handina kutanga kuparidzira Madovi. Ndakatanga kuparidzira hanzvadzi yake yainzi, Perestenzia. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Perestenzia ndiye akatanga kunamata, ndokunokwezva ruzevha rwe… [Congregation says, “rwese.”] Ndokuuya kwaMadovi manje uya uyu. Vaiva vapfanha vomuShurugwi umu. Ndeve kumusha kwana Pastor Chuma uko, heh? Mungaone dumbu riya richihwaio, hakuna zviriko. [Congregation laughs—ED] NdiMwari uya akazomeresa dumbu ri…? [Congregation says, “riya.”] Vaziva inonzi Me…? [Congregation says, “Message.”]

entries.title: The Revelation prt 14
entries.text: Vana Keyo ndakavatora dziri mbavha dzakanga dzine court case, vabatwa vachiba ma deo ma OK, muno mutawundi muna First Street. [Congregation laughs—ED] Aika. Isu ndisu takatovaita kuti vave va… zvavave nhasi. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Asi ndisu vacho vaipa, ivo vana…? [Congregation says, “vanaka.”] Mudekwa ndakatora mu boy-sky, achipfeka chikabudura che BSA—British eh, South African eh, [Congregation says, “Police,”] Police Force. [Congregation laughs—ED] Ndopandakatora munhu waMwari uya achigara mu boy sky. Taitoti tikaenda pamba pake, ndini ndaienda pamba pake, ndichinoparidza mumba make, achigara nehanzvadzi dzake dzimwe dzashaya iyezveno. Aigara kuseri uko, ku boy sky uko. Ndokwaaigara uko. Ndopandakatanga kumuparidzira …?... Vana Sister Musasa zvazviri zvana izvi. Heeeh. Mudekwa kwakuzoti kwakwanu manje, … [1:19:56 inaudible] ndasimuka manje ndobva ndabuda. Manje kwaMudekwa kwakaoma. KwaMudekwa hakuna game iri funny.

entries.title: The Revelation prt 14
entries.text: Ndosaka makaona Mai Gwe, mwana hwava. Mai Musasa, mwana hwava. Endai munoona hanzvadzi yavo ina Madzingira uyu, headache dzacho hadzidii…? [Congregation says, “hadziperi.”] Anogara achingotemwa nemusoro, chipfuva, chipfuva. Handi’taivanamatira last week. Hameno ane chinhu chake ikokoku chinonetsa vanhu. But ukauya pano muZita raJeso, [Congregation says, “Amen,”] Hallelujah! [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Ha’moona kuti brother, vakadzimaidzwa naSatani paya? Ndokutorwa kwakuenda kune imwe chechi. He did not pray for revela…? [Congregation says, “revelation, Amen.”]

entries.title: The Revelation prt 14
entries.text: Vana Brother Musharu… Musharu ndakavinga ndega ku Fretcher, Bernard Mizeki yavharwa, ndokuuya kwa—kwaMusharu. Joyina ndakatochengeta kubva kubudirwa nemudzimu, aida kuiswa zita ro—ro—romusha. Ndichivigira ma cassettes kuDhayadhaya. Hah? Ndosaka kana ukaona munhu achitaura kuti, “Brother Gumbura havana Mwari,” chinongozonakidza ndechekuti, iye Mwari wacho haavadii…? [Apostle and Congregation say, “haavazive.”] Ndiyaniko akati Mwari wakavasiya? [Congregation laughs—ED] Ndiyani wakati…

entries.title: The Revelation prt 14
entries.text: [Apostle laughs—ED] Heh, hanzi, “Ndiyani wakavati Mwari wakavadii…?” [Congregation says, “wakavasiya.”] Heh? Ndichisiiwa naMwari kupiko, ini? Inini I… Mukaona ha—ha—haku… Mukaona zvichinzi Mwari andisiya handitika? Hakuna atorwa. Ndozvazvinodii…? [Congregation says, “zvazvinoreva.”] Ehe, tafoira to…? [Congregation says, “tose, Amen.”]

entries.title: The Revelation prt 14
entries.text: Hongu ndoziva kuti ma brothers nema sisters mazhinji ari muno anonamata. Handishore kunamata kwenyu. But handifungi kuti vaviri vanonamata seni. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Nekuti ini ndinoziva kuti kana ndikapfugama ndichinamata; zvandinonzwa, nezvinodaira Mwari, nezvinoita denga, ini ndikanamata denga rinodaira. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Aaamen! [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Zvandotoziva kuti Mwari vada…? [Congregation says, “vadaira.”] Iko kutova pano patiri ipo panapa, mut—kudairwa kweyi uku? [Congregation says, “kwemunamato/muteuro, Amen.”]

entries.title: The Revelation prt 14
entries.text: Moti ndaizoimbireiko, Madairiro Enyu Emui…? [Congregation says, “Emunamato, Amen.”] Fungai marwisirwo andinoitwa nevanhu vese, asi ndine congregation yakadaio muHarare. Heh? I don’t care about their thousands but this quality iri muno yevapfanha …?... nema sisters ari munomu, any pastor would die to have a Church like this. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Ndochokwadi chizere icho…? [Congregation says, “ichocho, Amen.”]

entries.title: The Revelation prt 14
entries.text: Loyalty yacho. Commitment yacho. Cleanliness yacho. Holiness ya…? [Apostle and Congregation says, “yacho.”] Kubva kwavakaita kumushonga, kumudzimu, hadzizi mbiri chechi dzaunosvika uchiwana dzakaita seinoyi. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Muno unotarisa munhu uchinyatsoziva kuti mupfanha uyu zango haa…? [Congregation says, “haana.”] Mucheka mutema haa...? [Congregation says, “haana.”] Makuva haadii uyu…? [Congregation says, “haarove.”] He has no charm! [Congregation says, “Amen.”] He lives by God’s grace every day. [Congregation says, “Amen.”]

entries.title: The Revelation prt 14
entries.text: Ndosaka makwayi angu vanhu vaya. Ndosaka mukaona nyangwe… Hakuna mwana anotuka baba zvikashanda. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Ndosaka mukaona vanenge vachingoti, “Gumbura uya achafa. Gumbura uya achaparara.” Handiparari. Anoparara ndiani? [Congregation says, “ndivo, Amen.”] VaChitsinde vakati vaaona makwayi aya zvikanzi, “Vakomana, vakomana, vakoma…”

entries.title: The Revelation prt 14
entries.text: Vaone Crosby, havazive kupona kwake. Vana Fombe; Francis, havazive kupona kwavo. Ha’moona? Vanoziva kupona kwana Francis Fombe? Havavazive. Kungokumba vanhu chete. Womira pa purupiti manje wotanga kutema varume vacho. “Ndimi vanhu chete vauya pano imimi nekuti makurumbidza kujekerwa. Rume riya riya…” Zvino iye… anobva adaidza muchato wake. Woti, “Huyai kumuchato. Huyai kumuchato, musi we Saturday.” Brother? Kwakaita muchato ne Saturday kuHarare kunhingi ku—ku—ku church ikoko last week. Hakuna kana munhu one akadii…? [Congregation says, “akaenda.”] Vaipopota ne Sunday. “Manga muri kupi? Makanga muri kupi?”

entries.title: The Revelation prt 14
entries.text: Kwakayenda vedu. Idzidziso yani iyoyo? [Congregation says, “yenyu/yepano.”] Idzidziso yemuRevhi. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Amen! [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Idzidziso ya Pastor Gumbura. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Ndosaka nanhasi ndino challenger chechi dziri mu Message, muno muZimbabwe muno... Haumbowane chechi dzakabatana sei…? [Congregation says, “seino.”] Hakuna. Isu parufu. [Apostle claps once in demonstration of unity—ED] Pamuchato. [Apostle claps once in demonstration of unity—ED] Pama service. [Apostle claps once in demonstration of unity—ED]

entries.title: The Revelation prt 14
entries.text: “What do you give them?” We give them Go…? [Congregation says, “Gospills.”] Tingaite Amen here ipapo hama? [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Toda Amen akadarika ipapo. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Handisi kumunzwa Amen iyeye? [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Ndosaka mukaona ha’moona? Mwari vakabva vanyora zvikanzi, “Aah ah. Murume wese muti.” [Congregation says, “Amen.”]

entries.title: The Revelation prt 14
entries.text: Ini ndotori muti. Iwe uri chii? [Congregation says, “chibereko.”] But kana muti uri wenhundurwa, unotemha chii pauri? [Congregation says, “ndundurwa.”] Kana muti uri mu orange, unotemha chii? [Congregation says, “ma orange.”] Kana muti uri ma guava, unotemha chii? [Congregation says, “ma guava.”] Hapana munhu anotemha ma guava, panhundurwa. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Hatiitei Amen varanda vaMwari! [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Toda Amen akadarika ipapo! [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Handisi kumunzwa Amen iyeye? [Congregation says, “Amen.”]

entries.title: The Revelation prt 14
entries.text: Ende mese munogamuchira kuti makadzidza kunamata pano. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Ndosaka ndinonakidzwa pese pandinoona vana Kiro. [Crosby—ED] Paakauya… “Sekuru, hakuna munhu aikukundai kuparidza imi panyika pano. Maiparidza imimi.” Ha’moona zvaari kutaura? Ari kuti mayi…? Ko zvanhasi anozviziva sei? Ha’moona mafungiro evanhu ava? Nezuro tete, zvikanzi, “Ndasangana nevanhu vatiri kuda, vanoita zve construction, vana Mugugu. Eh, vanoita zve construction. Saka vanga vachiti vanokuzivai, makamboparidza pane rumwe rufu kudai. Vachiti, ‘Haah, murume uya dai asina kuparidza polygamy, i number one. Kwakazobva ne polygamy ndokupiko?’”

entries.title: The Revelation prt 14
entries.text: Muri kuona pfungwa dzavo? Zvekugona kuparidza kana kusagona kuparidza haisi nyaya. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Nyaya hombe ndeyekuti panopona vanhu here ipapo? [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Hatiitei Amen ipapo. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Panorerwa here vana, nevakomana, nevasikana, varume nemadzimai? [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Vachikudza mhuri dzavo, makuva vasingaro...? [Congregation says, “vasingarove.”] Mazango vasingaba...? [Congregation says, “vasingabati.”] Mishonga vasingabate. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Asi Mwari achivapa mabasa nemari. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Zviri kuitika here pano izvozvo? [Congregation says, “Amen.”]

entries.title: The Revelation prt 14
entries.text: Ndosaka ini ndinotenda kuti [Apostle knocks pulpit twice—ED] vanhu vandakatanga navo chaivo chaivo, dai ndakanga ndisiri waMwari ndakangofanana navo. Takatanga nana Brother Musharu, ndovana baba vana Zipporah ava, havachanamata. Vana Emmanuel Runyanga havachanamata. Takanamata navo vakomana ivavo, vakawanda. Hameno zvakavawana mukukura umu, vakangosiyana nechekunamata. Ko isu chakatichengeta…? [Apostle and Congregation say, “chii?”]

entries.title: The Revelation prt 14
entries.text: Hamuzirimi makwayi edu ekutanga. Makwayi edu ekutanga akadzokera kumai…? [Congregation says, “kumashure.”] Ko chii chinoita kuti kurambe kuchiuya vanhu? Handidi kukunyeperai, “Beware of false prophets...” [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Mu Message ma false prophets awa...? [Congregation says, “awanda.”] Kuma denomination, it goes without sa...? [Congregation says, “say.”] But muporofita wechokwadi, pastor vechokwadi, unovaziva nezvibereko zvaani…? [Congregation says, “zvavo, Amen.”] Ndoda Amen akadarika Amen. [Congregation says, “Amen.”]

entries.title: The Revelation prt 14
entries.text: Saka unofanira kuti ukasvika kuna Thembi, woti, “Nhai Thembi, wakanyatsopona here pawakauya pasi peshumiro yaVaGumbura?” Kana Thembi akaita sister uyu, chimwe chinhu chakaitika muchipfuva chake, ndini ndakachiita? Ndiani? [Congregation says, “NdiMwari.”] That’s how you know a pastor. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Wosvika woti, “Keith kana kuti Nyaude, wakapona here chaizvo chai…?” [Congregation says “chaizvo.”] Kana vapfanha vakapona zvekuti vakaregera mbanje, vakaregera vasikana, vakatambira chipikirwa choMweya Mutsvene, akazviita ndiani? [Congregation says, “ndiMwari.”] Heh? Muri kuzvionaka varanda vaMwari? [Congregation says, “Amen.”]

entries.title: The Revelation prt 14
entries.text: Nhasi unoona Va Doc [doctor—ED] vachibva ku Botswana, kuuya kuShoko raani…? [Congregation says, “raMwari.”] Kubva riri jaya, kusvika aroora. Iye zvino atarisira mhuri yake. Nei? Tarirai vana brother ava, kubva Bindura uko, Botswana. Vadii kubuda kuenda kunorova eeh, beer, hah? Kutamba nevasikana. Mari yavapozve? Muzvambarara wemo…? [Congregation says, “wemota,”] wemota. Hm? Chii chinenge chakaitika? Ndiri kuvabata nenyanga yangu vakomana ava? Kune nyanga inoita kuti munhu agare akatendeka, aite conscience, arare anamata, averenge Bhaibhiri, akunde mahure, akunde zvikomba, nyanga? “Ho-o? Nyanga dza’akuponesa?”

entries.title: The Revelation prt 14
entries.text: Chinoponesa iRopa! [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Ndoda Amen varanda vaMwari. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Ndoda Amen akadarika ipapo. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Chinoporesa chii varanda vaMwari? [Congregation says, “iRopa, Amen, Hallelujah, Amen.”] Chinoporesa iRopa. Ndosaka munhu nemunhu akapona panapa, i confirmation yekuti wakaparidzirwa, nemunhu anenge akatumwa noMweya waani…? [Apostle knocks on the pulpit and Congregation says, “waMwari.”] Ndokupona kwawakadii…? [Apostle knocks on the pulpit and Congregation says, “kwawakaita.”] Hativerengei tone. Right tichipedza hedu. Verse 18 tese, handei pa verse 18 tese: A good tree cannot bring forth evil fruit, neither can a corrupt tree bring forth good fruit. Verse 19: Every tree that bringeth not forth good fruit is hewn down, and cast into the fire. Verse 20: Wherefore by their fruits ye shall know them.

entries.title: The Revelation prt 14
entries.text: Toda Amen akadarika Amen! [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Toda Amen akadarika ipapo! [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Chechi ine mweya wetsvina uchaiwona nema—nemakwayi anobuda ipa…? [Congregation says, “ipapo.”] Chechi ine Mweya waMwari uchawona nemakwayi anobuda ipa…? [Congregation says, “ipapo.”] Makwayi ndiwo anoratidza chibereko chevanhu. entries.text: [Apostle chuckles—ED] Inini ndikaparidzira munhu wese, even ukaenda ku Russia, unonoita number one ikoko. entries.text: Hakuna, even musikana wandinoparidzira ukapinda… Nhasi uno ukapinda kuchechi… Even ukaenda kunopinda ku Celebration Centre, ukangoita one-month uripo, pastor vachada kukuziva kuti ndiwe ani? entries.text: Munhu nemunhu ngaanamate manheru anhasi vanhu vaMwari. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Nhasi izuva redu reChishanu iri. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] “Ndapinda paChechi apa kwemakore but handitombozive kuti mufundisi ndiani. Ndingazoitewo hupenzi hwekuti ndagara paChechi twenty years, ndongowomoka kubvapo. entries.title: The Revelation prt 14
entries.text: Ndakaona Brother Witness vachiuya vari mwana wechikoro, iye zvino akuzviseenzera. Vana Brother Nyaude ava, vakuzviitira zvima projects zvavo ku town uku. Vakawuya vari vana vezvikoro, vari vapfanha vatatu. Handi’moziva kuti vaiva vari vatatu vapfanha ava? Vana Brother Magunde ava, vakauya vachibva kuzvikoro handiti? entries.text: Vana Brother Gwendere ava, vakawuya vari vana vezviko…? [Congregation says “vezvikoro.”] Mwari akadaira muteuro here varanda vaMwari? entries.title: The Revelation prt 14
entries.text: Until zvatinoita isusu zvinoita sevanhu vane zvikwambo, nekuti hazviitwe nemunhu asina Mwari. Kana munhu asina Mwari, unotofanira kuva musho…? [Congregation says, “mushonga.”] Kana pasina mushonga ndiyani…? [Congregation says “ndiMwari.”] Vanhu venyika kuti vatiti tina Mwari, havagone kuzvigamuchira. entries.text: Ndosaka iwewe iti, “Mwari ndiitirei nyasha manheru anhasi. [Congregation says, ‘Amen.’] Ndoda kubuda muno ndagamuchira chipikirwa choMweya Mui…? entries.text: Muranda waMwari, Mwari vari pano. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Pavanouya havadzokere vasina kuzadzikisa chavavinga. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Pese pavauya, vanounza salvation. entries.title: The Revelation prt 14
entries.text: Izuva redu rokuti tigugudze Mwari vazarure. [Apostle knocks on pulpit several times—ED; Congregation says, “Amen.”] “Mwari tiri kuda one accord. [Apostle knocks on pulpit several times—ED; Congregation says, ‘Amen.’] Mwari dzorerai simba kuMwenga!” [Apostle knocks on pulpit several times—ED; Congregation says, “Amen.”] Hallelujah, Hallelujah! entries.text: Manheru ano unogona kubuda muno wasunungurwa hanzvadzi. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Unogona kusunungurwa nhasi manheru ano hama. entries.text: Tisati tavhara nemuteuro, ndoda kuti mumwe nemumwe wedu, just for a few more minutes, [Congregation says, “Amen,”] ngaaise one of the requests we have got. entries.text: Hatisakanganwa mweya wa October. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Amen. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Mweya wekuti Mwenga udzoreredzwe. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Mwenga uve nesimba Rawo. entries.text: Baba tinotenda manheru anhasi. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Mwari izuva ramakatipa rekuzvitsaura. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Kuti Baba wakanaka tione kukundwa kwewakaipa.
